ayahs.transliteration: atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহর নির্দেশ এসে গেছে, অতএব এর জন্য তাড়াহুড়ো করো না। তিনি মহান পবিত্র, তারা যাকে শরীক সাব্যস্ত করে তাত্থেকে তিনি বহু ঊর্ধ্বে।
ayahs.translation_en: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.conventional_en: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহর আদেশ এসে গেছে; অতএব তোমরা তা ত্বরান্বিত করতে চেয়ো না। তিনি পবিত্র ও মহান — তারা যা শরীক করে, তা থেকে তিনি বহু ঊর্ধ্বে।

english_translations.sahih_international: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
english_translations.pickthall: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) the Command of Allah: seek ye not then to hasten it: Glory to Him, and far is He above having the partners they ascribe unto Him!
english_translations.shakir: Allah's commandment has come, therefore do not desire to hasten it; glory be to Him, and highly exalted be He above what they associate (with Him).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God's help will certainly support (the believers), so pagans do not (seek) to hasten it. God is too Glorious and Exalted to be considered equal to idols.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: The Event (the Hour or the punishment of disbelievers and polytheists or the Islamic laws or commandments), ordained by Allah will come to pass, so seek not to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate as partners with Him.
english_translations.arberry: God's command comes; so seek not to hasten it. Glory be to Him! High be He exalted above that they associate with Him!

ayahs.transliteration: yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūni
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি তাঁর এ রূহকে (ওহীক) যে বান্দাহর উপর চান স্বীয় নির্দেশক্রমে ফেরেশতাদের মাধ্যমে অবতীর্ণ করেন (এই মর্মে যে) তোমরা সতর্ক কর যে, আমি ছাড়া সত্যিকারের কোন ইলাহ নেই, কাজেই আমাকে ভয় কর।
ayahs.translation_en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
ayahs.conventional_en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি ফেরেশতাদেরকে তাঁর আদেশক্রমে রূহ (ওহী) সহ নাযিল করেন — তাঁর বান্দাদের মধ্যে যাকে ইচ্ছা — (এই বলে) যে, 'তোমরা সতর্ক করো যে, আমি ছাড়া কোনো উপাস্য নেই; অতএব তোমরা আমাকেই ভয় করো।'

english_translations.sahih_international: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
english_translations.pickthall: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He doth send down His angels with inspiration of His Command, to such of His servants as He pleaseth, (saying): "Warn (Man) that there is no god but I: so do your duty unto Me."
english_translations.shakir: He sends down the angels with the inspiration by His commandment on whom He pleases of His servants, saying: Give the warning that there is no god but Me, therefore be careful (of your duty) to Me.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He sends the angels with the Spirit to carry His orders to whichever of His servants He wants so that they would warn people that He is the only God and that people must have fear of Him.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He sends down the angels with inspiration of His Command to whom of His slaves He pleases (saying): "Warn mankind that La ilaha illa Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so fear Me (by abstaining from sins and evil deeds).
english_translations.arberry: He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whomsoever He will among His servants, saying: Give you warning that there is no God hut I; so fear you Me!

ayahs.transliteration: khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি (বিশেষ উদ্দেশ্য সাধনের নিমিত্তে) প্রকৃতভাবেই আসমানসমূহ যমীন সৃষ্টি করেছেন, তারা যাকে আল্লাহর অংশীদার গণ্য করে তাত্থেকে তিনি বহু ঊর্ধ্বে।
ayahs.translation_en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.conventional_en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি আসমানসমূহ ও জমিনকে সত্যের সাথে সৃষ্টি করেছেন; তারা যা শরীক করে, তা থেকে তিনি বহু ঊর্ধ্বে।

english_translations.sahih_international: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
english_translations.pickthall: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He has created the heavens and the earth for just ends: Far is He above having the partners they ascribe to Him!
english_translations.shakir: He created the heavens and the earth with the truth, highly exalted be He above what they associate (with Him).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He has created the heavens and the earth for a genuine purpose. He is too Exalted to be considered equal to anything else.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all they associate as partners with Him.
english_translations.arberry: He created the heavens and the earth in truth; high be He exalted above that they associate With Him!

ayahs.transliteration: khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি শুক্র-কীট থেকে মানুষ সৃষ্টি করেছেন অথচ সে প্রকাশ্য ঝগড়াটে সেজে বসল।
ayahs.translation_en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
ayahs.conventional_en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি মানুষকে বীর্য থেকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন; অতঃপর সে তো স্পষ্ট বিতণ্ডাকারী।

english_translations.sahih_international: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
english_translations.pickthall: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He has created man from a sperm-drop; and behold this same (man) becomes an open disputer!
english_translations.shakir: He created man from a small seed and lo! he is an open contender.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He created the human being from a drop of fluid but the human being openly disputes His Word.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He has created man from Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.
english_translations.arberry: He created man of a sperm-drop; and, behold, he is a manifest adversary.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি চতুস্পদ জন্তু সৃষ্টি করেছেন এবং তাতে তোমাদের জন্য আছে (শীত) নিবারক আর বহু উপকারিতাও, আর সেগুলো থেকে তোমরা আহার কর।
ayahs.translation_en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.conventional_en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তিনি তোমাদের জন্য চতুষ্পদ জন্তু সৃষ্টি করেছেন; তাতে তোমাদের জন্য রয়েছে উষ্ণতা ও বিভিন্ন উপকারিতা; এবং তোমরা তা থেকে খাও।

english_translations.sahih_international: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
english_translations.pickthall: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And ye have a sense of pride and beauty in them as ye drive them home in the evening, and as ye lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
english_translations.shakir: And there is beauty in them for you when you drive them back (to home), and when you send them forth (to pasture).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: How beautiful you find them when you bring them home and when you drive them out to graze.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And wherein is beauty for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
english_translations.arberry: and there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them forth abroad to pasture;

ayahs.transliteration: wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun
ayahs.translation_bn: আর এগুলো তোমাদের ভার বোঝা বহন ক’রে এমন স্থান পর্যন্ত নিয়ে যায়, প্রাণান্তকর ক্লেশ ছাড়া যেখানে তোমরা পৌঁছতে পারতে না, তোমাদের প্রতিপালক অবশ্যই বড়ই দয়ার্দ্র, বড়ই দয়ালু।
ayahs.translation_en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা তোমাদের ভারবাহী বোঝা নিয়ে যায় এমন শহরে, যেখানে তোমরা পৌঁছতে পারতে না — প্রাণপণ চেষ্টা ছাড়া। নিশ্চয় তোমাদের রব অত্যন্ত দয়ালু, পরম দয়াময়।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ (প্রানান্ত) — শব্দমূল [ن ف س]: তাদের নিজেদেরকে; মানব মনস্তত্ত্ব, আত্মচেতনা, স্বতন্ত্র ইচ্ছাশক্তি ও জৈবিক সত্তার সমন্বিত রূপ।; رَّحِيمٌۭ (পরম দয়ালু) — শব্দমূল [ر ح م]: পরম করুণাময়; মাতৃগর্ভের মতো পরম সুরক্ষাদায়ী মমতা, সর্বব্যাপী দয়া ও ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ যত্ন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
english_translations.pickthall: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that ye could not (otherwise) reach except with souls distressed: for your Lord is indeed Most Kind, Most Merciful,
english_translations.shakir: And they carry your heavy loads to regions which you could not reach but with distress of the souls; most surely your Lord is Compassionate, Merciful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They carry your heavy loads to lands which you would not have been able to reach without great difficulty. Your Lord is certainly Compassionate and All-Merciful.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful.
english_translations.arberry: and they bear your loads unto a land that you never would reach, excepting with great distress. Surely your Lord is All-clement, All-compassionate.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি ঘোড়া, খচ্চর ও গর্দভ সৃষ্টি করেছেন যাতে তোমরা ওগুলোতে আরোহণ করতে পার আর শোভা-সৌন্দর্যের জন্যও; তিনি পয়দা করেন অনেক কিছু যা তোমাদের জানা নেই।
ayahs.translation_en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর (তিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন) ঘোড়া, খচ্চর ও গাধা — যাতে তোমরা সেগুলোতে আরোহণ করো এবং (সেগুলো) শোভাস্বরূপ; আর তিনি এমন জিনিস সৃষ্টি করেন যা তোমরা জান না।
ayahs.meta_bn: বাহন সৃষ্টি ও অজানা প্রযুক্তির ইঙ্গিত

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَيَخْلُقُ (এবং তিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন) — শব্দমূল [خ ل ق]: তোমাদের সৃষ্টি করেছেন; পরম নিখুঁত নকশা ও অনুপাত অনুযায়ী শূন্য থেকে নবসৃষ্টি রূপায়ণ।; وَٱلْخَيْلَ (এবং ঘোড়া (সৃষ্টি করেছেন)) — শব্দমূল [خ ي ل]: ও ঘোড়ার; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'ও ঘোড়ার'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And (He has created) horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and use for show; and He has created (other) things of which ye have no knowledge.
english_translations.shakir: And (He made) horses and mules and asses that you might ride upon them and as an ornament; and He creates what you do not know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He created horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and as a means of beauty. He has also created things that you do not know.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge.
english_translations.arberry: And horses, and mules, and asses, for you to ride, and as an adornment; and He creates what you know not.

ayahs.transliteration: waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহরই দায়িত্বে রয়েছে সরল পথপ্রদর্শন। পথগুলোর মধ্যে বাঁকা পথও আছে। তিনি যদি ইচ্ছে করতেন তাহলে অবশ্যই তোমাদের সকলকেই সঠিক পথ প্রদর্শন করতেন।
ayahs.translation_en: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.conventional_en: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর সঠিক পথের দিকনির্দেশনা আল্লাহর দায়িত্ব; আর কিছু পথ বাঁকা; আর যদি তিনি চাইতেন, তবে তিনি তোমাদের সকলকে পথপ্রদর্শন করতেন।
ayahs.meta_bn: সরল পথ প্রদর্শন ও বাঁকা পথ

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ (আল্লাহর (দায়িত্ব)) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; لَهَدَىٰكُمْ (অবশ্যই সৎপথে পরিচালনা করতেন তোমাদের) — শব্দমূল [ه د ي]: আমাদেরকে দেখান; অপ্টিমাইজড পথনির্দেশ, সত্যের আলো এবং জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ সঠিক অক্ষ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And unto Allah leads straight the Way, but there are ways that turn aside: if Allah had willed, He could have guided all of you.
english_translations.shakir: And upon Allah it rests to show the right way, and there are some deviating (ways); and if He please He would certainly guide you all aright.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Some paths lead away from God but one must follow the path that leads to God. Had God wanted, He could have guided (all to the right path).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And upon Allah is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path (i.e. Islamic Monotheism for mankind i.e. to show them legal and illegal, good and evil things, etc. so, whosoever accepts the guidance, it will be for his own benefit and whosoever goes astray, it will be for his own destruction), but there are ways that turn aside (such as Paganism, Judaism, Christianity, etc.). And had He willed, He would have guided you all (mankind).
english_translations.arberry: God's it is to show the way; and some do swerve from it. If He willed, He would have guided you all together.

ayahs.transliteration: huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করেন যাতে আছে তোমাদের জন্য পানীয় আর তাতে জন্মে বৃক্ষ লতা যা তোমাদের পশুগুলোকে খাওয়াও।
ayahs.translation_en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
ayahs.conventional_en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনিই আসমান থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করেন; তা থেকে তোমাদের পানীয়, এবং তা থেকে গাছপালা, যাতে তোমরা পশু চড়াও করো।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلسَّمَآءِ (আকাশ) — শব্দমূল [س م و]: নামে; মহাজাগতিক স্তরবিন্যাস, মহাশূন্য, স্পেস-টাইম মেট্রিক ও বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় সপ্তস্তর (Atmospheric & Cosmic Stratification)।; مَآءًۭ ۖ (পানি) — শব্দমূল [م و ه]: পানি; সর্বজনীন জৈব দ্রাবক (H2O), সেলুলার প্রোটোপ্লাজম ও কার্বন-ভিত্তিক প্রাণের মূল ভিত্তি।

english_translations.sahih_international: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
english_translations.pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is He who sends down rain from the sky: from it ye drink, and out of it (grows) the vegetation on which ye feed your cattle.
english_translations.shakir: He it is Who sends down water from the cloud for you; it gives drink, and by it (grow) the trees upon which you pasture.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who sends down water from the sky for you to drink and produces plants as pasture for your cattle.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He it is Who sends down water (rain) from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture;
english_translations.arberry: It is He who sends down to you out of heaven water of which you have to drink, and of which trees, for you to pasture your herds,

ayahs.transliteration: yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি তা দিয়ে তোমাদের জন্য জন্মান শস্য, যায়তূন, খেজুর, আঙ্গুর এবং সর্বপ্রকার ফল। এতে চিন্তাশীল মানুষদের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।
ayahs.translation_en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.conventional_en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি তা দিয়ে তোমাদের জন্য শস্য, জলপাই, খেজুর, আঙ্গুর এবং সকল প্রকার ফল উৎপন্ন করেন; নিশ্চয় এতে চিন্তাশীল সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: يُنۢبِتُ (তিনি উদগত করেন) — শব্দমূল [ن ب ت]: উৎপাদন করে; বীজ থেকে ভ্রূণমূল ও কাণ্ডের উন্মেষ, ক্লোরোফিল সক্রিয়করণ ও সেলুলার বায়োমাস উৎপাদন।; ٱلزَّرْعَ (শস্য) — শব্দমূল [ز ر ع]: ও ফসল; বীজ বপন, অঙ্কুরোদগম ও মানবজাতির প্রধান খাদ্যশস্যের জৈবিক উৎপাদন।

english_translations.sahih_international: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
english_translations.pickthall: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: With it He produces for you corn, olives, date-palms, grapes and every kind of fruit: verily in this is a sign for those who give thought.
english_translations.shakir: He causes to grow for you thereby herbage, and the olives, and the palm trees, and the grapes, and of all the fruits; most surely there is a sign in this for a people who reflect.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (With this water) He causes corn, olives, palm-trees, vines, and all kinds of fruits to grow. In this there is evidence (of the existence of God) for the people of understanding.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily! In this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought.
english_translations.arberry: and thereby He brings forth for you crops, and olives, and palms, and vines, and all manner of fruit. Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect.

ayahs.transliteration: wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনিই রাত ও দিনকে তোমাদের উপকারে নিয়োজিত করেছেন। আর সুরুজ ও চাঁদকেও; এবং তারকারাজিও তাঁরই নির্দেশে নিয়ন্ত্রিত; বিবেকসম্পন্ন লোকেদের জন্য এতে অবশ্যই বহু নিদর্শন রয়েছে।
ayahs.translation_en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.conventional_en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তিনি তোমাদের জন্য রাত, দিন, সূর্য ও চন্দ্রকে অনুগত করেছেন; আর নক্ষত্রসমূহ তাঁর আদেশে অনুগত; নিশ্চয় এতে বোধশক্তিসম্পন্ন সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلَّيْلَ (রাতকে) — শব্দমূল [ل ي ل]: রাত; আহ্নিক ঘূর্ণনে আলোর আড়াল, বিশ্রাম, মেলাটোনিন নিঃসরণ ও সার্কেডিয়ান রিদম (Circadian Rhythm)।; وَٱلنَّهَارَ (ও দিনকে) — শব্দমূল [ن ه ر]: ঝর্ণাধারা; সূর্যালোকের উন্মোচন, সক্রিয় মেটাবলিজম ও জীবনের কর্মমুখর দিবাচক্র।

english_translations.sahih_international: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
english_translations.pickthall: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He has made subject to you the Night and the Day; the sun and the moon; and the stars are in subjection by His Command: verily in this are Signs for men who are wise.
english_translations.shakir: And He has made subservient for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon, and the stars are made subservient by His commandment; most surely there are signs in this for a people who ponder;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has made the day and the night, the sun and the moon, and all the stars subservient to you by His command. In this there is evidence of the truth for people of understanding.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And He has subjected to you the night and the day, the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand.
english_translations.arberry: And He subjected to you the night and day, and the sun and moon; and the stars are subjected by His command. Surely in that are signs for a people who understand.

ayahs.transliteration: wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর তিনি তোমাদের জন্য যমীনে বিভিন্ন রং-এর বস্তুরাজি সৃষ্টি করেছেন। এতে ঐ সমস্ত লোকেদের জন্য নিশ্চিতভাবে নিদর্শন আছে যারা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করতে চায়।
ayahs.translation_en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
ayahs.conventional_en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তিনি তোমাদের জন্য পৃথিবীতে বিভিন্ন রঙের জিনিস সৃষ্টি করেছেন; নিশ্চয় এতে উপদেশ গ্রহণকারী সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
english_translations.pickthall: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And the things on this earth which He has multiplied in varying colours (and qualities): verily in this is a sign for men who celebrate the praises of Allah (in gratitude).
english_translations.shakir: And what He has created in the earth of varied hues most surely there is a sign in this for a people who are mindful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: All that He has created for you on the earth are of different colors. In this there is evidence of the Truth for the people who take heed.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And whatsoever He has created for you on this earth of varying colours [and qualities from vegetation and fruits, etc. (botanical life) and from animal (zoological life)]. Verily! In this is a sign for people who remember.
english_translations.arberry: And that which He has multiplied for you in the earth of diverse hues. Surely in that is a sign for a people who remember.

ayahs.transliteration: wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনিই সমুদ্রকে কল্যাণে নিয়োজিত রেখেছেন যাতে তোমরা তাত্থেকে তাজা গোশত খেতে পার, আর তাত্থেকে তোমরা রত্নরাজি সংগ্রহ করতে পার যা তোমরা অলংকার হিসেবে পরিধান কর। আর নৌযানগুলোকে তোমরা দেখতে পাও ঢেউয়ের বুক চিরে তাতে চলাচল করে, যাতে তোমরা তাঁর অনুগ্রহ তালাশ করতে পার আর শোকর আদায় করতে পার।

words.translation_bn: এবং যেন তোমরা সন্ধান করতে পারো

ayahs.translation_en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.conventional_en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তিনিই সমুদ্রকে অনুগত করেছেন, যাতে তোমরা তা থেকে তাজা মাংস খাও এবং তা থেকে অলংকার বের করো, যা তোমরা পরিধান করো; আর তুমি দেখতে পাও নৌকাকে সমুদ্রে জল বিভক্ত করে চলতে; এবং যাতে তোমরা তাঁর অনুগ্রহ অনুসন্ধান করো; এবং যাতে তোমরা কৃতজ্ঞ হও।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْبَحْرَ (সমুদ্রকে) — শব্দমূল [ب ح ر]: সাগরকে; সুবিশাল হাইড্রোস্ফিয়ার, সামুদ্রিক বাস্তুতন্ত্র ও বৈশ্বিক তাপ নিয়ন্ত্রক কনভেয়ার বেল্ট।; لَحْمًۭا ((মাছ) গোশত) — শব্দমূল [ل ح م]: মাংস; অস্থি কাঠামোর ওপর মাংসপেশি ও সংযোজক কলার সুরক্ষামূলক আবরণ আচ্ছাদন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
english_translations.pickthall: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is He Who has made the sea subject, that ye may eat thereof flesh that is fresh and tender, and that ye may extract therefrom ornaments to wear; and thou seest the ships therein that plough the waves, that ye may seek (thus) of the bounty of Allah and that ye may be grateful.
english_translations.shakir: And He it is Who has made the sea subservient that you may eat fresh flesh from it and bring forth from it ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships cleaving through it, and that you might seek of His bounty and that you may give thanks.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who put the oceans at your disposal so that you could find therein fresh fish for food and ornaments with which to deck yourselves with. You will find ships that sail for you so that you may travel in search of the bounties of God and give Him thanks.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And He it is Who has subjected the sea (to you), that you eat thereof fresh tender meat (i.e. fish), and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek (thus) of His Bounty (by transporting the goods from place to place) and that you may be grateful.
english_translations.arberry: It is He who subjected to you the sea, that you may eat of it fresh flesh, and bring forth out of it ornaments for you to wear; and thou mayest see the ships cleaving through it; and that you may seek of His bounty, and so haply you will be thankful.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি যমীনে সুদৃঢ় পর্বত সংস্থাপিত করেছেন যাতে যমীন তোমাদেরকে নিয়ে আন্দোলিত না হয়, আর সংস্থাপিত করেছেন নদী নির্ঝরিণী আর পথ যাতে তোমরা পথের সন্ধান পেতে পার।
ayahs.translation_en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
ayahs.conventional_en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তিনি পৃথিবীতে স্থির পর্বত স্থাপন করেছেন, যাতে তা তোমাদের নিয়ে কেঁপে না ওঠে; এবং নদ-নদী ও পথসমূহ — যাতে তোমরা সঠিক পথ পাও।

english_translations.sahih_international: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
english_translations.pickthall: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And He has set up on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads; that ye may guide yourselves;
english_translations.shakir: And He has cast great mountains in the earth lest it might be convulsed with you, and rivers and roads that you may go aright,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has fixed the mountains on earth lest you should be hurled away when it quakes. Therein He has also made rivers and roads so that you will find your way.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you, and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves.
english_translations.arberry: And He cast on the earth firm mountains, lest it shake with you, and rivers and ways; so haply you will be guided;

ayahs.transliteration: waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর দিক-দিশা প্রদানকারী চিহ্নসমূহ; আর তারকারাজির সাহায্যেও তারা পথনির্দেশ লাভ করে।
ayahs.translation_en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
ayahs.conventional_en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর (তিনি তৈরি করেছেন) নিদর্শনসমূহ; এবং তারা নক্ষত্রের মাধ্যমেও পথপ্রাপ্ত হয়।

english_translations.sahih_international: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
english_translations.pickthall: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And marks and sign-posts; and by the stars (men) guide themselves.
english_translations.shakir: And landmarks; and by the stars they find the right way.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The stars and other signs also help people to find their way.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And landmarks (signposts, etc. during the day) and by the stars (during the night), they (mankind) guide themselves.
english_translations.arberry: and waymarks; and by the stars they are guided.

ayahs.transliteration: afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যিনি সৃষ্টি করেন তিনি কি তার মত যে সৃষ্টি করে না? তবে কি তোমরা শিক্ষা গ্রহণ করবে না?
ayahs.translation_en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
ayahs.conventional_en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
ayahs.conventional_bn: যিনি সৃষ্টি করেন, তিনি কি তাদের মত হতে পারেন, যারা সৃষ্টি করে না? তোমরা কি উপদেশ গ্রহণ করো না?

english_translations.sahih_international: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
english_translations.pickthall: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Is then He Who creates like one that creates not? Will ye not receive admonition?
english_translations.shakir: Is He then Who creates like him who does not create? Do you not then mind?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Is the One who can create equal to the one who cannot create anything? Why, then, will you not consider?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Is then He, Who creates as one who creates not? Will you not then remember?
english_translations.arberry: Is He who creates as he who does not create? Will you not remember?

ayahs.transliteration: wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmun
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা আল্লাহর নি‘মাতসমূহকে গণনা করলে তার সংখ্যা নির্ণয় করতে পারবে না; আল্লাহ অবশ্যই বড়ই ক্ষমাশীল, বড়ই দয়ালু।
ayahs.translation_en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যদি তোমরা আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহ গণনা করতে চাও, তবে তা কখনো গণনা করতে পারবে না। নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ অত্যন্ত ক্ষমাশীল, পরম দয়ালু।

english_translations.sahih_international: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
english_translations.pickthall: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If ye would count up the favours of Allah, never would ye be able to number them: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_translations.shakir: And if you would count Allah's favors, you will not be able to number them; most surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Even if you wanted to count up all of God's blessings, you would not be able to. God is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And if you would count the graces of Allah, never could you be able to count them. Truly! Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
english_translations.arberry: If you count God's blessing, you will never number it; surely God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna

ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ জানেন যা তোমরা গোপন করো এবং যা তোমরা প্রকাশ করো।

english_translations.pickthall: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And Allah doth know what ye conceal, and what ye reveal.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you do openly.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God knows all that you conceal or reveal.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
english_translations.arberry: And God knows what you keep secret and what you publish.

ayahs.translation_en: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
ayahs.conventional_en: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যাদেরকে তারা আল্লাহকে ছাড়া ডাকে, তারা কিছুই সৃষ্টি করে না; বরং তারা নিজেরাই সৃষ্ট।

english_translations.sahih_international: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.

english_translations.yusuf_ali: Those whom they invoke besides Allah create nothing and are themselves created.
english_translations.shakir: And those whom they call on besides Allah have not created anything while they are themselves created;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whatever (idols) they worship besides God can create nothing for they are themselves created.

ayahs.transliteration: amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা প্রাণহীন, জীবিত নয়, তাদের কোনই চেতনা নেই কবে তাদেরকে (পুনর্জীবিত করে) উঠানো হবে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: أَمْوَٰتٌ ((তারা) মৃত) — শব্দমূল [م و ت]: মৃত্যুর; সেলুলার অ্যাপোপটোসিস, জৈবিক ক্রিয়াকলাপের সমাপ্তি ও থার্মোডাইনামিক এন্ট্রপিক বিয়োজন।; أَحْيَآءٍۢ ۖ (জীবিত) — শব্দমূল [ح ي ي]: লজ্জাবোধ করেন; সেলুলার মেটাবলিজম, স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত প্রাণস্পন্দন, বৃদ্ধি ও সজীব সিস্টেম।

english_translations.sahih_international: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
english_translations.pickthall: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (They are things) dead, lifeless: nor do they know when they will be raised up.
english_translations.shakir: Dead (are they), not living, and they know not when they shall be raised.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They are not living but are dead. They can not know when they will be raised.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (They are) dead, lifeless, and they know not when they will be raised up.
english_translations.arberry: dead, not alive; and are not aware when they shall be raised.

ayahs.transliteration: ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাদের ইলাহ হলেন এক ইলাহ। কাজেই যারা আখেরাতে বিশ্বাস করে না, তাদের অন্তর সত্য-অস্বীকারকারী আর তারা অহংকারী।
ayahs.translation_en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমাদের উপাস্য একক উপাস্য; অতএব যারা আখিরাতে বিশ্বাস করে না, তাদের অন্তর অস্বীকার করে; এবং তারা অহংকারী।

english_translations.sahih_international: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
english_translations.pickthall: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Your Allah is one Allah: as to those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant.
english_translations.shakir: Your Allah is one Allah; so (as for) those who do not believe in the hereafter, their hearts are ignorant and they are proud.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord is only One. The hearts of those who do not believe in the life hereafter dislike (the truth). They are puffed up with pride.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Your Ilah (God) is One Ilah (God Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but He). But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts deny (the faith in the Oneness of Allah), and they are proud.
english_translations.arberry: Your God is One God. And they who believe not in the world to come, their hearts deny, and they have waxed proud.

ayahs.transliteration: lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīna

ayahs.translation_en: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_en: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_bn: নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ জানেন যা তারা গোপন করে এবং যা তারা প্রকাশ করে; নিশ্চয় তিনি অহংকারীদের পছন্দ করেন না।

english_translations.arberry: Without a doubt God knows what they keep secret and what they publish; He loves not those that wax proud.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā qīla lahum mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū asāṭīru l-awalīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদেরকে যখন বলা হয়, ‘তোমাদের প্রতিপালক কী নাযিল করেছেন’ তখন তারা বলে- ‘পূর্ববর্তীদের কল্প-কাহিনী’।
ayahs.translation_en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
ayahs.conventional_en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন তাদের বলা হয়, 'তোমাদের রব কী নাযিল করেছেন?' তারা বলে, 'এগুলো তো পূর্ববর্তীদের উপকথা।'

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: قِيلَ (বলা হয়) — শব্দমূল [ق و ل]: বলে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'বলে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।; أَنزَلَ (অবতীর্ণ করেছেন) — শব্দমূল [ن ز ل]: অবতীর্ণ করা হয়েছে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'অবতীর্ণ করা হয়েছে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
english_translations.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When it is said to them, "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" they say, "Tales of the ancients!"
english_translations.shakir: And when it is said to them, what is it that your Lord has revealed? They say: Stories of the ancients;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When they are asked, "What has your Lord revealed to you?" they say, "Only ancient legends".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when it is said to them: "What is it that your Lord has sent down (unto Muhammad SAW)?" They say: "Tales of the men of old!"
english_translations.arberry: And when it is said to them, 'What has your Lord sent down?' they say, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients.'

ayahs.transliteration: liyaḥmilū awzārahum kāmilatan yawma l-qiyāmati wamin awzāri alladhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿil'min alā sāa mā yazirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যার ফলে ক্বিয়ামাত দিবসে তারা বহন করবে নিজেদের পাপের বোঝা পূর্ণ মাত্রায়, আর (আংশিক) তাদেরও পাপের বোঝা যাদেরকে তারা গুমরাহ করেছে নিজেদের অজ্ঞতার কারণে। হায়, তারা যা বহন করবে তা কতই না নিকৃষ্ট!
ayahs.translation_en: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
ayahs.conventional_en: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যাতে তারা কিয়ামতের দিন তাদের নিজেদের পুরো বোঝা বহন করে, এবং যাদেরকে তারা অজ্ঞানতার সাথে পথভ্রষ্ট করে, তাদের বোঝাও বহন করে। সাবধান! তারা যা বহন করবে, তা কত নিকৃষ্ট!

ayahs.meta_en: The Compounded Burden of Misleading Others
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: يُضِلُّونَهُم (তারা বিভ্রান্ত করেছে তাদেরকে) — শব্দমূল [ض ل ل]: পথভ্রষ্টদের; সঠিক অক্ষ থেকে ছিটকে পড়ে উদ্দেশ্যহীন অন্ধ গোলকধাঁধায় ঘুরপাক খাওয়া।; لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ (যেন তারা বহন করে) — শব্দমূল [ح م ل]: তা বহন করে চলছে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'তা বহন করে চলছে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
english_translations.pickthall: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Let them bear, on the Day of Judgment, their own burdens in full, and also (something) of the burdens of those without knowledge, whom they misled. Alas, how grievous the burdens they will bear!
english_translations.shakir: That they may bear their burdens entirely on the day of resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they lead astray without knowledge; now surely evil is what they bear.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Besides their own burdens, on the Day of Judgment, they will have to carry on the burdens of those whom they have misled without knowledge. How evil that burden will be!
english_translations.mohsin_khan: They will bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also of the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear!
english_translations.arberry: That they may bear their loads complete on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the loads of those that they lead astray without any knowledge. O evil the load they bear!

ayahs.transliteration: qad makara alladhīna min qablihim fa-atā l-lahu bun'yānahum mina l-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu l-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের পূর্বে যারা ছিল তারাও চক্রান্ত করেছিল। ফলে আল্লাহ তাদের ইমারাতকে মূল থেকে উৎপাটিত করেছিলেন আর উপর থেকে ছাদ তাদের উপর ভেঙ্গে পড়ল, আর তাদের প্রতি শাস্তি পতিত হল এমন দিক হতে যা তারা এতটুকু টের পায়নি।
ayahs.translation_en: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.conventional_en: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তাদের পূর্ববর্তীরাও তো ষড়যন্ত্র করেছিল; অতঃপর আল্লাহ তাদের ভিত্তি থেকে তাদের অট্টালিকা ধ্বংস করলেন; অতঃপর তাদের ওপর থেকে ছাদ তাদের ওপর পড়ে গেল; আর তাদের কাছে শাস্তি এল এমন দিক থেকে, যা তারা অনুভবও করতে পারেনি।

ayahs.meta_en: The Structural Demolition of Tyrant Foundations
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; مَكَرَ (চক্রান্ত করেছিলো) — শব্দমূল [م ك ر]: এবং তারা ষড়যন্ত্র করল; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'এবং তারা ষড়যন্ত্র করল'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
english_translations.pickthall: Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Those before them did also plot (against Allah's Way): but Allah took their structures from their foundations, and the roof fell down on them from above; and the Wrath seized them from directions they did not perceive.
english_translations.shakir: Those before them did indeed devise plans, but Allah demolished their building from the foundations, so the roof fell down on them from above them, and the punishment came to them from whence they did not perceive.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Those who went before them had also devised evil plans. God demolished their houses, destroying their very foundations. Their ceilings toppled on their heads and torment struck them from a direction which they had never expected.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Those before them indeed plotted, but Allah struck at the foundation of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them, from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive.
english_translations.arberry: Those that were before them contrived; then God came upon their building from the foundations, and the roof fell down on them from over them, and the chastisement came upon them from whence they were not aware.

ayahs.transliteration: thumma yawma l-qiyāmati yukh'zīhim wayaqūlu ayna shurakāiya alladhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim qāla alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma inna l-khiz'ya l-yawma wal-sūa ʿalā l-kāfirīna
ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর ক্বিয়ামাত দিনে তিনি তাদেরকে অপমানিত করবেন আর বলবেন, ‘আমার অংশীদাররা কোথায় যাদের সম্পর্কে তোমরা (ঈমানদারদের সঙ্গে) বাক-বিতন্ডা করতে?’ যাদেরকে (দুনিয়ায়) জ্ঞান দেয়া হয়েছিল তারা বলবে, ‘আজ অপমান আর দুর্ভাগ্য তো কাফিরদের জন্য
ayahs.translation_en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
ayahs.conventional_en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর কিয়ামতের দিন তিনি তাদের অপমানিত করবেন এবং বলবেন, 'আমার সেই শরীকরা কোথায়, যাদের নিয়ে তোমরা বিতর্ক করতে?' যাদেরকে জ্ঞান দেওয়া হয়েছে, তারা বলবে, 'নিশ্চয় আজকের অপমান ও শাস্তি কাফিরদের জন্যই।'

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: شُرَكَآءِىَ (আমার শরীকরা) — শব্দমূল [ش ر ك]: শিরক করে; একক স্রষ্টার সঙ্গে অন্য কাউকে অংশীদার করে অস্তিত্বের সার্বজনীন ঐক্যে ফাটল ধরানো।; ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ (কাফেরদের") — শব্দমূল [ك ف ر]: অবিশ্বাস করেছে; সত্যের সুস্পষ্ট আলো দেখেও তা মাটিচাপা দিয়ে গোপন করা বা অবাধ্যতায় লিপ্ত থাকা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
english_translations.pickthall: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will cover them with shame, and say: "Where are My 'partners' concerning whom ye used to dispute (with the godly)?" Those endued with knowledge will say: "This Day, indeed, are the Unbelievers covered with shame and misery,-
english_translations.shakir: Then on the resurrection day He will bring them to disgrace and say: Where are the associates you gave Me, for whose sake you became hostile? Those who are given the knowledge will say: Surely the disgrace and the evil are this day upon the unbelievers:
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God will humiliate them on the Day of Judgment and ask them, "Where are the idols which you had considered equal to Me and which were the cause of hostility and animosity among you?" The people who were given knowledge will say, "It is the unbelievers who face disgrace and trouble on this day."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: "Where are My (so called) 'partners' concerning whom you used to disagree and dispute (with the believers, by defying and disobeying Allah)?" Those who have been given the knowledge (about the Torment of Allah for the disbelievers) will say: "Verily! Disgrace this Day and misery are upon the disbelievers.
english_translations.arberry: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will degrade them, saying, 'Where are My associates concerning which you made a breach together?' Those that were given the knowledge will say, 'Degradation today and evil are on the unbelievers,

ayahs.transliteration: alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ẓālimī anfusihim fa-alqawū l-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūin balā inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: ফেরেশতারা যাদের মৃত্যু ঘটায় নিজেদের প্রতি যুলম করা অবস্থায়।’ অতঃপর তারা আত্মসমর্পণ ক’রে বলবে, ‘আমরা তো কোন খারাপ কাজ করতাম না।’ (ফেরেশতারা জবাব দিবে) ‘বরং, তোমরা যা করছিলে আল্লাহ সে বিষয়ে খুব ভালভাবেই অবগত।
ayahs.translation_en: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.
ayahs.conventional_en: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যাদেরকে ফেরেশতারা মৃত্যু দেয় — যারা নিজেদের ওপর জুলুম করে — তখন তারা আত্মসমর্পণ করে (বলে), 'আমরা কোনো মন্দ কাজ করিনি।' (বলা হবে) 'বরং, নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ তোমরা যা করতে, সে সম্পর্কে পূর্ণজ্ঞাত।'
ayahs.meta_bn: জালিমদের মৃত্যুর সময় মিথ্যা দাবি খণ্ডন

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ (ফেরেশতারা) — শব্দমূল [م ل ك]: মহাজাগতিক মৌলিক প্রাকৃতিক বলসমূহ ও কোয়ান্টাম চালিকাশক্তি; মহাবিশ্বের সমস্ত দৃশ্য-অদৃশ্য রাজত্ব ও সিস্টেমের ওপর অখণ্ড নিরঙ্কুশ সার্বভৌমত্ব।; ظَالِمِىٓ (অত্যাচারী অবস্থায়) — শব্দমূল [ظ ل م]: অন্ধকার সমূহের; সিস্টেমের সঠিক অবস্থান থেকে বিচ্যুত হয়ে অন্ধকার ও ধ্বংস ডেকে আনা।

english_translations.sahih_international: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.
english_translations.pickthall: Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "(Namely) those whose lives the angels take in a state of wrong-doing to their own souls." Then would they offer submission (with the pretence), "We did no evil (knowingly)." (The angels will reply), "Nay, but verily Allah knoweth all that ye did;
english_translations.shakir: Those whom the angels cause to die while they are unjust to themselves. Then would they offer submission: We used not to do any evil. Aye! surely Allah knows what you did.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The unjust, who will be seized by the angels, will submit themselves, obey, and say, "We were not evil-doers." But God certainly knows what they had been doing.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves (by disbelief and by associating partners in worship with Allah and by committing all kinds of crimes and evil deeds)." Then, they will make (false) submission (saying): "We used not to do any evil." (The angels will reply): "Yes! Truly, Allah is All-Knower of what you used to do.
english_translations.arberry: whom the angels take while still they are wronging themselves.' Then they will offer surrender: 'We were doing nothing evil. 'Nay; but surety God has knowledge of the things you did.

ayahs.transliteration: fa-ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā falabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna
ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই জাহান্নামের দরজায় প্রবেশ কর, সেখানে তোমাদেরকে চিরকাল থাকতে হবে, দাম্ভিকদের অবাসস্থল কতই না মন্দ!’
ayahs.translation_en: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_en: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতএব তোমরা জাহান্নামের দরজায় প্রবেশ করো, সেখানে স্থায়ীভাবে অবস্থান করো; অতএব অহংকারীদের আবাস কত নিকৃষ্ট!

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ (সুতরাং তোমরা প্রবেশ করো) — শব্দমূল [د خ ل]: ''তোমরা প্রবেশ কর; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে '''তোমরা প্রবেশ কর'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।; أَبْوَٰبَ (দরজাসমূহে) — শব্দমূল [ب و ب]: নগর দরজায়; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'নগর দরজায়'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
english_translations.pickthall: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "So enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein. Thus evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant."
english_translations.shakir: Therefore enter the gates of hell, to abide therein; so certainly evil is the dwelling place of the proud.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They will be commanded to enter hell to live therein forever. How terrible will be the place of the proud ones!
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and indeed, what an evil abode will be for the arrogant."
english_translations.arberry: So enter the gates of Gehenna, there to dwell forever.' Evil is the lodging of those that wax proud.

ayahs.transliteration: waqīla lilladhīna ittaqaw mādhā anzala rabbukum qālū khayran lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun walaniʿ'ma dāru l-mutaqīna
ayahs.translation_bn: মুত্তাকীদের যখন বলা হয়, ‘তোমাদের প্রতিপালক কী অবতীর্ণ করেছেন?’ তারা বলে, ‘যা কিছু উৎকৃষ্ট (তা-ই অবতীর্ণ করেছেন)।’ যারা সৎকর্ম করে তাদের জন্য এ দুনিয়াতে আছে কল্যাণ, আর তাদের পরকালের ঘর তো নিশ্চিতই কল্যাণকর। মুত্তাকীদের আবাসস্থল কতই না উত্তম!
ayahs.translation_en: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
ayahs.conventional_en: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যারা আল্লাহভীতি অবলম্বন করেছিল, তাদের বলা হলো, 'তোমাদের রব কী নাযিল করেছেন?' তারা বলল, 'কল্যাণ।' যারা ইহলোকে সৎকর্ম করেছে, তাদের জন্য কল্যাণ রয়েছে; আর আখিরাতের আবাস তো উত্তম; আর আল্লাহভীরুদের আবাস কতই না চমৎকার!

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱتَّقَوْا۟ (তাকওয়া অবলম্বন করতো) — শব্দমূল [و ق ي]: মুত্তাকীদের জন্য; তাকওয়া — আল্লাহর অসন্তুষ্টি ও জাহান্নামের শাস্তি থেকে নিজেকে বাঁচাতে সততা ও সতর্কতার বর্ম পরিধান।; ۞ وَقِيلَ (এবং বলা হবে) — শব্দমূল [ق و ل]: বলে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'বলে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
english_translations.pickthall: And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil) -
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To the righteous (when) it is said, "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" they say, "All that is good." To those who do good, there is good in this world, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better and excellent indeed is the Home of the righteous,-
english_translations.shakir: And it is said to those who guard (against evil): What is it that your Lord has revealed? They say, Good. For those who do good in this world is good, and certainly the abode of the hereafter is better; and certainly most excellent is the abode of those who guard (against evil);
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones will be asked, "What did your Lord reveal to you?" They will reply, "He revealed only good." The share of the righteous ones is virtue in this world and greater virtue in the life to come. How blessed will be the dwelling of the pious ones!
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) "What is it that your Lord has sent down?" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2).
english_translations.arberry: And it shall be said to the godfearing, 'What has your Lord sent down?' They will say, 'Good! For those who do good in this world good; and surely the abode of the world to come is better; excellent is the abode of the godfearing --

ayahs.transliteration: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yashāūna kadhālika yajzī l-lahu l-mutaqīna
ayahs.translation_bn: (তা হল) স্থায়ী জান্নাত যাতে তারা প্রবেশ করবে, তার নিম্নদেশ দিয়ে ঝর্ণাধারা প্রবাহিত, তারা যা ইচ্ছে করবে সেখানে তাদের জন্য তা-ই আছে- আল্লাহ মুত্তাকীদেরকে এভাবেই পুরস্কৃত করেন।
ayahs.translation_en: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -
ayahs.conventional_en: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -
ayahs.conventional_bn: স্থায়ী জান্নাত, যাতে তারা প্রবেশ করবে; তার নিচ দিয়ে নদী প্রবাহিত হবে; সেখানে তারা যা ইচ্ছা পাবে; এভাবেই আল্লাহ মুত্তাকিদের প্রতিদান দেন।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ (ঝর্ণাধারাসমূহ) — শব্দমূল [ن ه ر]: ঝর্ণাধারা; সূর্যালোকের উন্মোচন, সক্রিয় মেটাবলিজম ও জীবনের কর্মমুখর দিবাচক্র।; ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -
english_translations.pickthall: Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil),
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Gardens of Eternity which they will enter: beneath them flow (pleasant) rivers: they will have therein all that they wish: thus doth Allah reward the righteous,-
english_translations.shakir: The gardens of perpetuity, they shall enter them, rivers flowing beneath them; they shall have in them what they please. Thus does Allah reward those who guard (against evil),
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They will be admitted into the gardens of Eden wherein steams flow and they will have therein whatever they want. This is how God will reward the pious ones.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: 'Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity) which they will enter, under which rivers flow, they will have therein all that they wish. Thus Allah rewards the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2).
english_translations.arberry: Gardens of Eden they shall enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they shall have all they will. So God recompenses the godfearing,

ayahs.transliteration: alladhīna tatawaffāhumu l-malāikatu ṭayyibīna yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ud'khulū l-janata bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: ফেরেশতা যাদের মৃত্যু ঘটায় পবিত্র অবস্থায় এই ব’লে যে, ‘তোমাদের উপর শান্তি বর্ষিত হোক, তোমরা যে ‘আমাল করতে তার ফল হিসেবে জান্নাতে প্রবেশ কর।’

words.translation_en: while in a state of goodness

ayahs.translation_en: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
ayahs.conventional_en: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
ayahs.conventional_bn: যাদেরকে ফেরেশতারা মৃত্যু দেয় — তারা পবিত্র অবস্থায় — তারা বলে, 'তোমাদের প্রতি শান্তি বর্ষিত হোক; তোমরা জান্নাতে প্রবেশ করো — যা করতে, তার প্রতিদানে।'
ayahs.meta_bn: পবিত্র অবস্থায় মৃত্যু ও শান্তির বার্তা

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ (ফেরেশতারা) — শব্দমূল [م ل ك]: মহাজাগতিক মৌলিক প্রাকৃতিক বলসমূহ ও কোয়ান্টাম চালিকাশক্তি; মহাবিশ্বের সমস্ত দৃশ্য-অদৃশ্য রাজত্ব ও সিস্টেমের ওপর অখণ্ড নিরঙ্কুশ সার্বভৌমত্ব।; سَلَـٰمٌ ("শান্তি) — শব্দমূল [س ل م]: সুস্থ্য; কোনো ত্রুটি বা সংঘাতহীন পরম অভ্যন্তরীণ ও সামাজিক ভারসাম্য ও প্রশান্তি।

english_translations.sahih_international: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
english_translations.pickthall: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (Namely) those whose lives the angels take in a state of purity, saying (to them), "Peace be on you; enter ye the Garden, because of (the good) which ye did (in the world)."
english_translations.shakir: Those whom the angels cause to die in a good state, saying: Peace be on you: enter the garden for what you did.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They will be received by the angels of mercy with the greeting, "Peace be with you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your good deeds."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Those whose lives the angels take while they are in a pious state (i.e. pure from all evil, and worshipping none but Allah Alone) saying (to them): Salamun 'Alaikum (peace be on you) enter you Paradise, because of (the good) which you used to do (in the world)."
english_translations.arberry: whom the angels take while they are goodly, saying, 'Peace be on you! Enter Paradise for that you were doing.'

ayahs.transliteration: hal yanẓurūna illā an tatiyahumu l-malāikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim wamā ẓalamahumu l-lahu walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা কি এই অপেক্ষায় আছে যে, ফেরেশতারা তাদের কাছে আসবে কিংবা তোমার প্রতিপালকের ফায়সালা এসে পড়বে? তাদের পূর্ববর্তীরাও এ রকমই করত। আল্লাহ তাদের প্রতি কোন যুলম করেননি বরং তারা নিজেরাই নিজেদের প্রতি যুলম করত।
ayahs.translation_en: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
ayahs.conventional_en: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা কি কেবল এই অপেক্ষা করে যে, তাদের কাছে ফেরেশতা আসবে? অথবা তোমার রবের আদেশ আসবে? তাদের পূর্ববর্তীরাও এভাবেই করেছিল; আর আল্লাহ তাদের ওপর জুলুম করেননি; বরং তারা নিজেরাই নিজেদের ওপর জুলুম করত।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ (ফেরেশতারা) — শব্দমূল [م ل ك]: মহাজাগতিক মৌলিক প্রাকৃতিক বলসমূহ ও কোয়ান্টাম চালিকাশক্তি; মহাবিশ্বের সমস্ত দৃশ্য-অদৃশ্য রাজত্ব ও সিস্টেমের ওপর অখণ্ড নিরঙ্কুশ সার্বভৌমত্ব।; ظَلَمَهُمُ (তাদের উপর অত্যাচার করেছেন) — শব্দমূল [ظ ل م]: অন্ধকার সমূহের; সিস্টেমের সঠিক অবস্থান থেকে বিচ্যুত হয়ে অন্ধকার ও ধ্বংস ডেকে আনা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
english_translations.pickthall: Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do the (ungodly) wait until the angels come to them, or there comes the Command of thy Lord (for their doom)? So did those who went before them. But Allah wronged them not: nay, they wronged their own souls.
english_translations.shakir: They do not wait aught but that the angels should come to them or that the commandment of your Lord should come to pass. Thus did those before them; and Allah was not unjust to them, but they were unjust to themselves.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Are they (the disbelievers) waiting for the angels and the decree of your Lord to be fulfilled before they believe? The people who lived before them had also done the same thing. God did not do injustice to them, but they wronged themselves.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Do they (the disbelievers and polytheists) await but that the angels should come to them [to take away their souls (at death)], or there should come the command (i.e. the torment or the Day of Resurrection) of your Lord? Thus did those before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they used to wrong themselves.
english_translations.arberry: Do they look for aught but that the angels shall come to them, or thy Lord's command shall come? So did those before them, and God wronged them not, but themselves they wronged.

ayahs.transliteration: fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই তাদের ‘আমালের মন্দ পরিণতি তাদের উপর আপতিত হল আর যে বিষয়কে তারা ঠাট্টা-বিদ্রূপ করত তা-ই তাদেরকে ঘিরে ফেলল।
ayahs.translation_en: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.conventional_en: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর তাদের কৃতকর্মের মন্দ পরিণতি তাদেরকে পাকড়াও করল; আর তারা যা নিয়ে ঠাট্টা-বিদ্রুপ করত, তাই তাদেরকে ঘিরে ফেলল।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: فَأَصَابَهُمْ (অতঃপর তাদের উপর পড়েছিলো) — শব্দমূল [ص و ب]: মতো বৃষ্টিপাতের; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'মতো বৃষ্টিপাতের'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।; سَيِّـَٔاتُ (মন্দসমূহ (অর্থাৎ শাস্তি)) — শব্দমূল [س و ا]: নিকৃষ্ট; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'নিকৃষ্ট'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
english_translations.pickthall: So that the evils of what they did smote them, and that which they used to mock surrounded them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But the evil results of their deeds overtook them, and that very (Wrath) at which they had scoffed hemmed them in.
english_translations.shakir: So the evil (consequences) of what they did shall afflict them and that which they mocked shall encompass them.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The evil consequences of their deeds afflicted them and they were surrounded by what they had mocked.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Then, the evil results of their deeds overtook them, and that at which they used to mock surrounded them.
english_translations.arberry: So the evil things that they wrought. smote them, and they were encompassed by that they mocked at.

ayahs.transliteration: waqāla alladhīna ashrakū law shāa l-lahu mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shayin naḥnu walā ābāunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shayin kadhālika faʿala alladhīna min qablihim fahal ʿalā l-rusuli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu
ayahs.translation_bn: মুশরিকরা বলে, ‘আল্লাহ ইচ্ছে করলে তাঁকে বাদ দিয়ে অন্য কোন কিছুর ‘ইবাদাত আমরাও করতাম না, আর আমাদের পিতৃপুরুষরাও না, আর তাঁর হুকুম ছাড়া কোন কিছুকে হারাম গণ্যও করতাম না। তাদের পূর্ববর্তীরাও এ রকমই করত। (তারা রসূলদের কথা অমান্য করলে রসূলদের তো আর কিছুই করার নেই, কারণ) স্পষ্টভাবে পৌঁছে দেয়া ছাড়া রসূলদের উপর কি কোন দায়িত্ব আছে?
ayahs.translation_en: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
ayahs.conventional_en: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যারা শিরক করেছিল, তারা বলল, 'যদি আল্লাহ চাইতেন, তবে আমরা ও আমাদের পিতৃপুরুষরা তাঁর ছাড়া কিছুই পূজা করতাম না; আর আমরা তাঁর ছাড়া কিছুই হারাম করতাম না।' তাদের পূর্ববর্তীরাও এভাবেই করেছিল; তবে রাসূলগণের দায়িত্ব তো কেবল সুস্পষ্ট বার্তা পৌঁছে দেওয়া।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: أَشْرَكُوا۟ (শিরক করেছে) — শব্দমূল [ش ر ك]: শিরক করে; একক স্রষ্টার সঙ্গে অন্য কাউকে অংশীদার করে অস্তিত্বের সার্বজনীন ঐক্যে ফাটল ধরানো।; ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
english_translations.pickthall: And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The worshippers of false gods say: "If Allah had so willed, we should not have worshipped aught but Him - neither we nor our fathers,- nor should we have prescribed prohibitions other than His." So did those who went before them. But what is the mission of messengers but to preach the Clear Message?
english_translations.shakir: And they who give associates (to Allah) say: If Allah had pleased, we would not have served anything besides Allah, (neither) we nor our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything without (order from) Him. Thus did those before them; is then aught incumbent upon the apostles except a plain delivery (of the message)?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The pagans had said, "Had God wanted we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, nor would our fathers. We would not have forbidden anything without (a command from) Him." The same thing was said by the people who lived before them. Are the Messengers expected to do more than just preach?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And those who join others in worship with Allah say: "If Allah had so willed, neither we nor our fathers would have worshipped aught but Him, nor would we have forbidden anything without (Command from) Him." So did those before them. Then! Are the Messengers charged with anything but to convey clearly the Message?
english_translations.arberry: The idolators say, 'If God had willed we would not have served; apart from Him, anything, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden, apart from Him, anything.' So did those before them; yet is aught for the Messengers, but to deliver the manifest Message?

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad baʿathnā fī kulli ummatin rasūlan ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ij'tanibū l-ṭāghūta famin'hum man hadā l-lahu wamin'hum man ḥaqqat ʿalayhi l-ḍalālatu fasīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna
ayahs.translation_bn: প্রত্যেক জাতির কাছে আমি রসূল পাঠিয়েছি (এ সংবাদ দিয়ে) যে, আল্লাহর ‘ইবাদাত কর আর তাগুতকে বর্জন কর। অতঃপর আল্লাহ তাদের মধ্যে কতককে সৎপথ দেখিয়েছেন, আর কতকের উপর অবধারিত হয়েছে গুমরাহী, অতএব যমীনে ভ্রমণ করে দেখ, সত্য প্রত্যাখ্যানকারীদের পরিণতি কী ঘটেছিল!
ayahs.translation_en: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি প্রত্যেক উম্মতে রাসূল প্রেরণ করেছিলাম (এই বলে) যে, 'তোমরা আল্লাহর ইবাদত করো এবং তাগুতকে বর্জন করো।' অতঃপর তাদের মধ্যে কেউ কেউ আল্লাহ কর্তৃক পথপ্রাপ্ত হয়েছিল; আর তাদের মধ্যে কেউ কেউ পথভ্রষ্টতা সাব্যস্ত হয়েছিল। অতএব তোমরা পৃথিবীতে ভ্রমণ করো এবং দেখো, যারা মিথ্যা প্রত্যাখ্যান করেছিল, তাদের পরিণতি কেমন হয়েছিল!
