ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهَ (আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; هَدَى (সৎপথে পরিচালনা করেন) — শব্দমূল [ه د ي]: আমাদেরকে দেখান; অপ্টিমাইজড পথনির্দেশ, সত্যের আলো এবং জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ সঠিক অক্ষ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
english_translations.pickthall: And verily We have raised in every nation a messenger, (proclaiming): Serve Allah and shun false gods. Then some of them (there were) whom Allah guided, and some of them (there were) upon whom error had just hold. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for the deniers!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For We assuredly sent amongst every People a messenger, (with the Command), "Serve Allah, and eschew Evil": of the People were some whom Allah guided, and some on whom error became inevitably (established). So travel through the earth, and see what was the end of those who denied (the Truth).
english_translations.shakir: And certainly We raised in every nation an apostle saying: Serve Allah and shun the Shaitan. So there were some of them whom Allah guided and there were others against whom error was due; therefore travel in the land, then see what was the end of the rejecters.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: To every nation We sent a Messenger who told its people, "Worship God and stay away from satan." Some of them were guided by God and others were doomed to go astray. Travel through the land and see how terrible was the end for those who rejected the truth!
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily, We have sent among every Ummah (community, nation) a Messenger (proclaiming): "Worship Allah (Alone), and avoid (or keep away from) Taghut (all false deities, etc.i. e. do not worship Taghut besides Allah)." Then of them were some whom Allah guided and of them were some upon whom the straying was justified. So travel through the land and see what was the end of those who denied (the truth).
english_translations.arberry: Indeed, We sent forth among every nation a Messenger,; saying: 'Serve you God, and eschew idols.' Then some. of them God guided, and some were justly disposed to error. So journey in the land, and behold how was the end of them that cried lies.

ayahs.transliteration: in taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna l-laha lā yahdī man yuḍillu wamā lahum min nāṣirīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তুমি যদি তাদের হিদায়াতের জন্য লালায়িত হও তবে (জেনে রেখে যে) আল্লাহ তাকে সৎপথ দেখান না যাকে তিনি বিপথগামী হতে ছেড়ে দেন আর তাদের কোন সাহায্যকারী নেই।
ayahs.translation_en: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
ayahs.conventional_en: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যদি তুমি তাদের পথপ্রাপ্তির জন্য উদগ্রীব হও, তবে নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ তাকে পথপ্রদর্শন করেন না, যাকে তিনি পথভ্রষ্ট করেন; আর তাদের কোনো সাহায্যকারী নেই।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: هُدَىٰهُمْ (তাদের পথ প্রদর্শনের তুমি) — শব্দমূল [ه د ي]: আমাদেরকে দেখান; অপ্টিমাইজড পথনির্দেশ, সত্যের আলো এবং জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ সঠিক অক্ষ।; ٱللَّهَ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
english_translations.pickthall: Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If thou art anxious for their guidance, yet Allah guideth not such as He leaves to stray, and there is none to help them.
english_translations.shakir: If you desire for their guidance, yet surely Allah does not guide him who leads astray, nor shall they have any helpers.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), even though you have a strong desire to guide them, be sure that God will not guide those who have gone astray and no one will be able to help them.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: If you (O Muhammad SAW) covet for their guidance, then verily Allah guides not those whom He makes to go astray (or none can guide him whom Allah sends astray). And they will have no helpers.
english_translations.arberry: Though thou art ever so eager to guide them, God guides not those whom He leads astray; they have no helpers.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim lā yabʿathu l-lahu man yamūtu balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা আল্লাহর নামে শক্ত কসম খেয়ে বলে, ‘যার মুত্যৃ ঘটে আল্লাহ তাকে পুনরায় জীবিত করবেন না।’ অবশ্যই করবেন, এটা তো একটা প্রতিশ্রুতি যা পূরণ করা তাঁর দায়িত্ব, কিন্তু অধিকাংশ মানুষই তা জানে না।
ayahs.translation_en: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা আল্লাহর নামে কঠোর শপথ করল যে, 'আল্লাহ মৃতকে পুনরুত্থিত করবেন না।' বরং, এটা তাঁর ওপর সত্য ওয়াদা; কিন্তু অধিকাংশ মানুষ জানে না।

english_translations.sahih_international: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: And they swear by Allah their most binding oaths (that) Allah will not raise up him who dieth. Nay, but it is a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They swear their strongest oaths by Allah, that Allah will not raise up those who die: Nay, but it is a promise (binding) on Him in truth: but most among mankind realise it not.
english_translations.shakir: And they swear by Allah with the most energetic of their oaths: Allah will not raise up him who dies. Yea! it is a promise binding on Him, quite true, but most people do not know;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They strongly swear by God that God will not bring the dead to life. God's promise (of the Resurrection) will certainly come true but many people do not know.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths, that Allah will not raise up him who dies. Yes, (He will raise them up), a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not.
english_translations.arberry: have sworn by God the most earnest oaths God will never raise up him who dies; nay, it is a promise binding upon Him, but most men know not,

ayahs.transliteration: liyubayyina lahumu alladhī yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama alladhīna kafarū annahum kānū kādhibīna
ayahs.translation_bn: (তাদেরকে পুনর্জীবিত করা হবে) যারা এ ব্যাপারে মতভেদ করেছিল তাদের কাছে স্পষ্ট করে দেয়ার জন্য, আর কাফিরগণ যাতে জানতে পারে যে, তারা ছিল মিথ্যেবাদী।
ayahs.translation_en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
ayahs.conventional_en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যাতে তিনি তাদের কাছে স্পষ্ট করে দেন যে, তারা কী নিয়ে মতভেদ করছিল; এবং যাতে যারা কুফর করেছে, তারা জানে যে, তারা মিথ্যাবাদী ছিল।

english_translations.sahih_international: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
english_translations.pickthall: That He may explain unto them that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (They must be raised up), in order that He may manifest to them the truth of that wherein they differ, and that the rejecters of Truth may realise that they had indeed (surrendered to) Falsehood.
english_translations.shakir: So that He might make manifest to them that about which they differ, and that those who disbelieve might know that they were liars.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Through the resurrection) God wants to make a clear distinction between right and wrong and make the unbelievers know that they were liars.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: In order that He may make manifest to them the truth of that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved (in Resurrection, and in the Oneness of Allah) may know that they were liars.
english_translations.arberry: so that He may make clear to them that whereon they were at variance, and that the unbelievers may know that they were truly liars.

ayahs.transliteration: innamā qawlunā lishayin idhā aradnāhu an naqūla lahu kun fayakūnu
ayahs.translation_bn: কোন বিষয়ে আমি ইচ্ছে করলে বলি, ‘হয়ে যাও’, ফলে তা হয়ে যায়।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আমাদের কোনো বস্তু সম্পর্কে বাণী — যখন আমরা তা করতে চাই — কেবল এই যে, আমরা তাকে বলি, 'হও,' আর তা হয়ে যায়।

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
english_translations.pickthall: And Our word unto a thing, when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: Be! and it is.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: For to anything which We have willed, We but say the word, "Be", and it is.
english_translations.shakir: Our word for a thing when We intend it, is only that We say to it, Be, and it is.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When We want to bring something into existence, Our command is, "Exist," and it comes into existence.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily! Our Word unto a thing when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: "Be!" and it is.
english_translations.arberry: The only words We say to a thing, when We desire it, is that We say to it 'Be,' and it is.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-alladhīna hājarū fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā ẓulimū lanubawwi-annahum fī l-dun'yā ḥasanatan wala-ajru l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যারা অত্যাচারিত হওয়ার পরও আল্লাহর পথে হিজরাত করেছে, আমি তাদেরকে অবশ্য অবশ্যই এ দুনিয়াতে উত্তম আবাস দান করব, আর আখেরাতের পুরস্কার তো অবশ্যই সবচেয়ে বড়। হায়, তারা যদি জানত!
ayahs.translation_en: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
ayahs.conventional_en: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যারা আল্লাহর পথে নির্যাতনের পর হিজরত করেছিল, আমি তাদের দুনিয়ায় উত্তম আবাস দেব; আর আখিরাতের পুরস্কার তো আরও মহান — যদি তারা জানত!

english_translations.sahih_international: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
english_translations.pickthall: And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To those who leave their homes in the cause of Allah, after suffering oppression,- We will assuredly give a goodly home in this world; but truly the reward of the Hereafter will be greater. If they only realised (this)!
english_translations.shakir: And those who fly for Allah's sake after they are oppressed, We will most certainly give them a good abode in the world, and the reward of the hereafter is certainly much greater, did they but know;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God settles those who leave their homes for His cause after having suffered injustice, in a prosperous dwelling in this life and greater rewards will be theirs in the life to come. Would that they knew this.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And as for those who emigrated for the Cause of Allah, after suffering oppression, We will certainly give them goodly residence in this world, but indeed the reward of the Hereafter will be greater, if they but knew!
english_translations.arberry: And those that emigrated in God's cause after they were wronged -- We shall surely lodge them in this world in a goodly lodging, and the wage of the world to come is greater, did they but know;

ayahs.transliteration: alladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: (আখেরাতের ঐ পুরস্কার তাদের জন্য) যারা ধৈর্যধারণ করে আর তাদের প্রতিপালকের উপর নির্ভর করে।
ayahs.translation_en: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
ayahs.conventional_en: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যারা ধৈর্য ধারন করে এবং তাদের রবের ওপর ভরসা করে।

english_translations.sahih_international: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
english_translations.pickthall: Such as are steadfast and put their trust in Allah.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (They are) those who persevere in patience, and put their trust on their Lord.
english_translations.shakir: Those who are patient and on their Lord do they rely.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (It is they) who have exercised patience and trust in their Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (They are) those who remained patient (in this world for Allah's sake), and put their trust in their Lord (Allah Alone).
english_translations.arberry: even such men as are patient, and put their trust in their Lord.

ayahs.transliteration: wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমার পূর্বে পুরুষ মানুষ ব্যতীত পাঠাইনি যাদের কাছে আমি ওয়াহী করতাম। তোমরা যদি না জান তাহলে তোমরা আল্লাহর কিতাব সম্পর্কে যারা অবগত তাদেরকে জিজ্ঞেস কর
ayahs.translation_en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি তোমার আগে মানুষ ছাড়া কাউকে রাসূল করে পাঠাইনি — যাদের কাছে আমি ওহী পাঠাতাম; অতএব তোমরা যদি না জানো, তবে জ্ঞানীদের জিজ্ঞাসা করো।
ayahs.meta_bn: মানব নবী ও আহলে যিকর অনুসন্ধান

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلذِّكْرِ ((ঐশী)জ্ঞান) — শব্দমূল [ذ ك ر]: তোমরা স্মরণ করো; স্মরণ, সচেতন মনোযোগ, সক্রিয় মেমোরি রিকল ও সোর্স কোডের সাথে সর্বদা সংযোগ রক্ষা।; أَرْسَلْنَا (আমরা পাঠিয়েছি) — শব্দমূল [ر س ل]: রাসূলদেরকে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'রাসূলদেরকে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not! -
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And before thee also the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: if ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
english_translations.shakir: And We did not send before you any but men to whom We sent revelation-- so ask the followers of the Reminder if you do not know--
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The Messengers whom We sent before you were mere mortals to whom We had sent with miracles and revelations. Ask those who know about the heavenly Books if you do not know about this.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We sent not (as Our Messengers) before you (O Muhammad SAW) any but men, whom We inspired, (to preach and invite mankind to believe in the Oneness of Allah). So ask of those who know the Scripture [learned men of the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)], if you know not.
english_translations.arberry: We sent not any before thee, except men to whom We revealed: 'Question the people of the Remembrance, if it should be that you do not know --

ayahs.transliteration: bil-bayināti wal-zuburi wa-anzalnā ilayka l-dhik'ra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: (অতীতের রসূলদেরকে পাঠিয়েছিলাম) স্পষ্ট প্রমাণাদি আর কিতাব দিয়ে; আর এখন তোমার প্রতি কুরআন অবতীর্ণ করছি মানুষকে স্পষ্টভাবে বুঝিয়ে দেয়ার জন্য যা তাদের প্রতি অবতীর্ণ করা হয়েছে আর যাতে তারা চিন্তা-ভাবনা করে।
ayahs.translation_en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
ayahs.conventional_en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (তাদের পাঠিয়েছিলাম) সুস্পষ্ট প্রমাণ ও কিতাবসমূহ সহ; আর আমি তোমার প্রতি জিকির (কুরআন) নাযিল করেছি, যাতে তুমি মানুষের কাছে সে বিষয় স্পষ্ট করো, যা তাদের প্রতি নাযিল করা হয়েছে; এবং যাতে তারা চিন্তা-গবেষণা করে।

ayahs.meta_en: The Hermeneutic Role of the Messenger
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلذِّكْرَ (উপদেশবাণী (কুরআন)) — শব্দমূল [ذ ك ر]: তোমরা স্মরণ করো; স্মরণ, সচেতন মনোযোগ, সক্রিয় মেমোরি রিকল ও সোর্স কোডের সাথে সর্বদা সংযোগ রক্ষা।; يَتَفَكَّرُونَ (চিন্তা-ভাবনা করে) — শব্দমূল [ف ك ر]: চিন্তা-ভাবনা করবে; মহাবিশ্ব ও প্রকৃতির নিদর্শন নিয়ে গভীর মননশীল গবেষণা ও চিন্তাভাবনা।

english_translations.sahih_international: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
english_translations.pickthall: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (We sent them) with Clear Signs and Books of dark prophecies; and We have sent down unto thee (also) the Message; that thou mayest explain clearly to men what is sent for them, and that they may give thought.
english_translations.shakir: With clear arguments and scriptures; and We have revealed to you the Reminder that you may make clear to men what has been revealed to them, and that haply they may reflect.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have revealed the Quran to you so that you could tell the people what has been revealed to them and so that perhaps they will think.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: With clear signs and Books (We sent the Messengers). And We have also sent down unto you (O Muhammad SAW) the reminder and the advice (the Quran), that you may explain clearly to men what is sent down to them, and that they may give thought.
english_translations.arberry: with the clear signs, and the Psalms; and We have sent down to thee the Remembrance that thou mayest make clear to mankind what was sent down to them; and so haply they will reflect.

ayahs.transliteration: afa-amina alladhīna makarū l-sayiāti an yakhsifa l-lahu bihimu l-arḍa aw yatiyahumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যারা (ইসলামের বিরুদ্ধে) কূট-কৌশল করছে তারা কি নির্ভয় হয়ে গেছে যে, আল্লাহ তাদেরকে যমীনে ধ্বসিয়ে দিবেন না, অথবা তাদের কাছে শাস্তি এসে পড়বে না এমন দিক থেকে যা তারা এতটুকুও টের পাবে না
ayahs.translation_en: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
ayahs.conventional_en: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
ayahs.conventional_bn: যারা মন্দ ষড়যন্ত্র করে, তারা কি নিশ্চিন্ত যে, আল্লাহ তাদেরকে পৃথিবীতে ধসিয়ে দেবেন? অথবা তাদের কাছে শাস্তি আসবে এমন দিক থেকে, যা তারা অনুভবও করতে পারে না?

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Ayah 45 Lexicon: Precision root-based semantic alignment under the divine operating system.
metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: أَفَأَمِنَ (তবে কি নির্ভয় হয়েছে) — শব্দমূল [ا م ن]: বিশ্বাস করে; অন্তরের গভীর প্রশান্তি, সত্যের প্রতি পূর্ণ আস্থা ও চিরন্তন নিরাপত্তার বলয়ে প্রবেশ।; ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
english_translations.pickthall: Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do then those who devise evil (plots) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up, or that the Wrath will not seize them from directions they little perceive?-
english_translations.shakir: Do they then who plan evil (deeds) feel secure (of this) that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that punishment may not overtake them from whence they do not perceive?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Can they who have devised evil plans expect to be safe from the command of God to the earth to swallow them up, or from a torment which might strike them from an unexpected direction?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Do then those who devise evil plots feel secure that Allah will not sink them into the earth, or that the torment will not seize them from directions they perceive not?
english_translations.arberry: Do they feel secure, those who devise evil things, that God will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the chastisement will not come upon them, from whence they are not aware?

ayahs.transliteration: aw yakhudhahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿ'jizīna
ayahs.translation_bn: কিংবা তাদের চলাফেরার ভিতরেই তিনি তাদেরকে পাকড়াও করবেন না, অতঃপর তারা তো তা ব্যর্থ করে দিতে পারবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
ayahs.conventional_en: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
ayahs.conventional_bn: অথবা তাদের চলাফেরার সময় তাদেরকে পাকড়াও করবেন? কিন্তু তারা তা ব্যর্থ করতে পারে না।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Ayah 46 Lexicon: Precision root-based semantic alignment under the divine operating system.
metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تَقَلُّبِهِمْ (তাদের চলাফেরার) — শব্দমূল [ق ل ب]: তাদের অন্তরের; হৃদয় ও অনুভূতির নিউরাল কেন্দ্র, গভীর সংবেদনশীলতা ও বোধশক্তির মিলনস্থল।; يَأْخُذَهُمْ (তাদের ধরবেন) — শব্দমূল [ا خ ذ]: নেওয়া হবে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'নেওয়া হবে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
english_translations.pickthall: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Or that He may not call them to account in the midst of their goings to and fro, without a chance of their frustrating Him?-
english_translations.shakir: Or that He may not seize them in the course of their journeys, then shall they not escape;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Are they confident that God will not seize them while they are on a journey? They will not be able to escape from God.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Or that He may catch them in the midst of their going to and fro (in their jobs), so that there be no escape for them (from Allah's Punishment)?
english_translations.arberry: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro, and they will not be able to frustrate Him?

ayahs.transliteration: aw yakhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun
ayahs.translation_bn: অথবা তিনি তাদেরকে পাকড়াও করবেন না যখন তারা আসন্ন মুসীবাতের চিন্তায় ভীত-সন্ত্রস্ত হয়ে থাকবে, (আসল কথা হল আল্লাহ মানুষকে খুবই অবকাশ দিয়ে থাকেন) কেননা তোমাদের প্রতিপালক অবশ্যই অতি দয়ার্দ্র, বড়ই দয়ালু।
ayahs.translation_en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অথবা তাদেরকে ধীরে ধীরে (শাস্তি দিয়ে) পাকড়াও করবেন? তবে নিশ্চয় তোমাদের রব অত্যন্ত দয়ালু, পরম দয়াময়।
ayahs.meta_bn: ধীরে ধীরে ক্ষয় বনাম পরম অনুগ্রহ

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تَخَوُّفٍۢ (ভীত সন্ত্রস্ত) — শব্দমূল [خ و ف]: কোনো ভয়; ভবিষ্যৎ অনিরাপত্তা ও বিপদের শঙ্কাজনিত মস্তিষ্কের এলার্ট সিগন্যাল ও উদ্বেগ।; رَّحِيمٌ (পরম দয়ালু) — শব্দমূল [ر ح م]: পরম করুণাময়; মাতৃগর্ভের মতো পরম সুরক্ষাদায়ী মমতা, সর্বব্যাপী দয়া ও ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ যত্ন।

english_translations.sahih_international: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
english_translations.pickthall: Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Or that He may not call them to account by a process of slow wastage - for thy Lord is indeed full of kindness and mercy.
english_translations.shakir: Or that He may not seize them by causing them to suffer gradual loss, for your Lord is most surely Compassionate, Merciful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Are they confident that God will not slowly destroy them? Your Lord is Compassionate and All-merciful.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Or that He may catch them with gradual wasting (of their wealth and health). Truly! Your Lord is indeed full of Kindness, Most Merciful?
english_translations.arberry: Or that He will not seize them, little by little destroying them? Surely thy Lord is All-clement, All-compassionate.

ayahs.transliteration: awalam yaraw ilā mā khalaqa l-lahu min shayin yatafayya-u ẓilāluhu ʿani l-yamīni wal-shamāili sujjadan lillahi wahum dākhirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা কি আল্লাহর সৃষ্টি করা জিনিসের দিকে লক্ষ্য করে না, যার ছায়া আল্লাহর প্রতি সাজদার অবস্থায় ডানে-বামে পতিত হয়, আর তারা বিনয় প্রকাশ করে?
ayahs.translation_en: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble.
ayahs.conventional_en: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা কি আল্লাহর সৃষ্ট কোনো জিনিসের দিকে তাকায় না, যার ছায়া ডান ও বামে ঢোলে — আল্লাহর জন্য সিজদাকারী অবস্থায়; আর তারা বিনয়ী?

english_translations.pickthall: Have they not observed all things that Allah hath created, how their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do they not look at Allah's creation, (even) among (inanimate) things,- How their (very) shadows turn round, from the right and the left, prostrating themselves to Allah, and that in the humblest manner?
english_translations.shakir: Do they not consider every thing that Allah has created? Its (very) shadows return from right and left, making obeisance to Allah while they are in utter abasement.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Can they not see that the shadows of whatever God has created turn to the right and to the left in prostration and submission to Him?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Have they not observed things that Allah has created, (how) their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly?
english_translations.arberry: Have they not regarded all things that God has created casting their shadows to the right and to the left, bowing themselves before God in all lowliness?

ayahs.translation_bn: আকাশসমূহ ও পৃথিবীতে যত জীব-জন্তু ফেরেশতারা, সমস্তই আল্লাহকে সাজদাহ করে; তারা অহঙ্কার করে না।
ayahs.translation_en: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_en: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহর জন্য সিজদা করে যা কিছু আসমানসমূহ ও জমিনে রয়েছে — সকল প্রাণী ও ফেরেশতারা; এবং তারা অহংকার করে না।

english_translations.sahih_international: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
english_translations.pickthall: And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And to Allah doth obeisance all that is in the heavens and on earth, whether moving (living) creatures or the angels: for none are arrogant (before their Lord).
english_translations.shakir: And whatever creature that is in the heavens and that is in the earth makes obeisance to Allah (only), and the angels (too) and they do not show pride.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth, the cattle and the angels prostrate themselves before God without pride.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And to Allah prostate all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, of the live moving creatures and the angels, and they are not proud [i.e. they worship their Lord (Allah) with humility].

ayahs.transliteration: yakhāfūna rabbahum min fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা তাদের উপরে আল্লাহকে ভয় করে আর তারা তা-ই করে যা তাদেরকে আদেশ দেয়া হয়। [সাজদাহ]
ayahs.translation_en: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
ayahs.conventional_en: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা তাদের রবকে ভয় করে — যিনি তাদের ওপর আধিপত্য বিস্তারকারী; এবং তারা যা আদেশ পায়, তা পালন করে।

english_translations.sahih_international: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
english_translations.pickthall: They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are bidden.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They all revere their Lord, high above them, and they do all that they are commanded.
english_translations.shakir: They fear their Lord above them and do what they are commanded.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They (angels) have fear of their Lord above them and fulfill His commands.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
english_translations.arberry: they fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

ayahs.transliteration: waqāla l-lahu lā tattakhidhū ilāhayni ith'nayni innamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun fa-iyyāya fa-ir'habūni
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ বললেন, ‘তোমরা দু’ ইলাহ গ্রহণ করো না, তিনি তো এক ইলাহ; কাজেই আমাকে- কেবল আমাকেই ভয় কর।’
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ বলেছেন, 'তোমরা দুই উপাস্য গ্রহণ করো না; নিশ্চয় তিনি একক উপাস্য; অতএব শুধু আমাকেই ভয় করো।'

ayahs.meta_en: The Prohibition of Dualism & Absolute Singularity
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; ۞ وَقَالَ (এবং বলেন) — শব্দমূল [ق و ل]: বলে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'বলে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."
english_translations.pickthall: Allah hath said: Choose not two gods. There is only One Allah. So of Me, Me only, be in awe.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Allah has said: "Take not (for worship) two gods: for He is just One Allah: then fear Me (and Me alone)."
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has said: Take not two gods, He is only one Allah; so of Me alone should you be afraid.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God says, "Do not worship two gods. There is only One God. Have fear of Me".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah said (O mankind!): "Take not ilahain (two gods in worship, etc.). Verily, He (Allah) is (the) only One Ilah (God). Then, fear Me (Allah) much [and Me (Alone), i.e. be away from all kinds of sins and evil deeds that Allah has forbidden and do all that Allah has ordained and worship none but Allah].
english_translations.arberry: God says: 'Take not to you two gods. He is only One God; so have awe of Me.'

ayahs.transliteration: walahu mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walahu l-dīnu wāṣiban afaghayra l-lahi tattaqūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আকাশসমূহ আর যমীনে যা কিছু আছে তা তাঁরই, আর দ্বীন সদা-সর্বদা একান্তভাবে তাঁরই জন্য। তাহলে তোমরা কি আল্লাহ ছাড়া অন্য কাউকে ভয় করবে?
ayahs.translation_en: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?
ayahs.conventional_en: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আসমানসমূহ ও জমিনে যা কিছু আছে, সব তাঁরই; আর চিরকালীন আনুগত্য তাঁরই প্রাপ্য; অতএব তোমরা কি আল্লাহ ছাড়া অন্যকে ভয় করো?

english_translations.sahih_international: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?
english_translations.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and on earth, and to Him is duty due always: then will ye fear other than Allah?
english_translations.shakir: And whatever is in the heavens and the earth is His, and to Him should obedience be (rendered) constantly; will you then guard against other than (the punishment of) Allah?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. God's retribution is severe. Should you then have fear of anyone other than God?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and (all that is in) the earth and Ad-Din Wasiba is His [(i.e. perpetual sincere obedience to Allah is obligatory). None has the right to be worshipped but Allah)]. Will you then fear any other than Allah?
english_translations.arberry: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and earth; His is the religion for ever. Then will you fear other than God?

ayahs.transliteration: wamā bikum min niʿ'matin famina l-lahi thumma idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fa-ilayhi tajarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যে নি‘মাতই তোমরা পেয়েছ তাতো আল্লাহর নিকট হতেই। আর যখন দুঃখ-কষ্ট তোমাদেরকে স্পর্শ করে, তখন তাঁর কাছেই তোমরা আকুল আবেদন জানাতে থাক।
ayahs.translation_en: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
ayahs.conventional_en: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমাদের প্রতি যা কিছু অনুগ্রহ আছে, তা আল্লাহর পক্ষ থেকে; অতঃপর যখন তোমাদের কষ্ট স্পর্শ করে, তখন তোমরা তাঁর কাছেই কাকুতি মিনতি করো।

ayahs.meta_en: The Origin of Sustenance & Cry in Distress
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ ۖ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; نِّعْمَةٍۢ (অনুগ্রহ (আছে)) — শব্দমূল [ن ع م]: আপনি অনুগ্রহ দান করেছেন; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'আপনি অনুগ্রহ দান করেছেন'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
english_translations.pickthall: And whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And ye have no good thing but is from Allah: and moreover, when ye are touched by distress, unto Him ye cry with groans;
english_translations.shakir: And whatever favor is (bestowed) on you it is from Allah; then when evil afflicts you, to Him do you cry for aid.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whatever bounties you have are from God. When hardship befalls you, you begin to cry out to Him.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And whatever of blessings and good things you have, it is from Allah. Then, when harm touches you, unto Him you cry aloud for help.
english_translations.arberry: Whatsoever blessing you have, it comes from God; then when affliction visits you it is unto Him that you groan.

ayahs.transliteration: thumma idhā kashafa l-ḍura ʿankum idhā farīqun minkum birabbihim yush'rikūna
ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর যখন তিনি তোমাদের থেকে দুঃখ-কষ্ট দূর করে দেন, তখন তোমাদের একদল তাদের প্রতিপালকের সঙ্গে অন্যকে শরীক করে বসে
ayahs.translation_en: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
ayahs.conventional_en: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

ayahs.transliteration: wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mimmā razaqnāhum tal-lahi latus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūna

ayahs.translation_en: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ (আত্ন গোপন করে) — শব্দমূল [و ر ي]: তা ছাড়া; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'তা ছাড়া'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।; ٱلْقَوْمِ (লোকদের) — শব্দমূল [ق و م]: সরল সঠিক; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'সরল সঠিক'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.
english_translations.pickthall: He hideth himself from the folk because of the evil of that whereof he hath had tidings, (asking himself): Shall he keep it in contempt, or bury it beneath the dust. Verily evil is their judgment.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: With shame does he hide himself from his people, because of the bad news he has had! Shall he retain it on (sufferance and) contempt, or bury it in the dust? Ah! what an evil (choice) they decide on?
english_translations.shakir: He hides himself from the people because of the evil of that which is announced to him. Shall he keep it with disgrace or bury it (alive) in the dust? Now surely evil is what they judge.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They try to hide themselves from the people because of the disgrace of such news. Will they keep their new born despite the disgrace or bury it alive? How sinful is their Judgment!
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He hides himself from the people because of the evil of that whereof he has been informed. Shall he keep her with dishonour or bury her in the earth? Certainly, evil is their decision.
english_translations.arberry: as he hides him from the people because of the evil of the good tidings that have been given unto him, whether he shall preserve it in humiliation, or trample it; into the dust. Ah, evil is that they judge!

ayahs.transliteration: lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu l-sawi walillahi l-mathalu l-aʿlā wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
ayahs.translation_bn: যারা আখেরাতে বিশ্বাস করে না, খারাপ উপমা তাদের জন্য। মহোত্তম উপমা সব আল্লাহর জন্য, তিনি হলেন প্রতাপান্বিত, প্রজ্ঞাময়।
ayahs.translation_en: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.conventional_en: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যারা আখিরাতে বিশ্বাস করে না, তাদের জন্য রয়েছে মন্দ দৃষ্টান্ত; আর আল্লাহর জন্য রয়েছে সর্বোত্তম দৃষ্টান্ত; আর তিনি পরাক্রমশালী, প্রজ্ঞাময়।

ayahs.meta_en: The Supreme Attribute belongs to Allah
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: يُؤْمِنُونَ (বিশ্বাস করে) — শব্দমূল [ا م ن]: বিশ্বাস করে; অন্তরের গভীর প্রশান্তি, সত্যের প্রতি পূর্ণ আস্থা ও চিরন্তন নিরাপত্তার বলয়ে প্রবেশ।; وَلِلَّهِ (এবং আল্লাহর জন্যে) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
english_translations.pickthall: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil similitude, and Allah's is the Sublime Similitude. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To those who believe not in the Hereafter, applies the similitude of evil: to Allah applies the highest similitude: for He is the Exalted in Power, full of Wisdom.
english_translations.shakir: For those who do not believe in the hereafter is an evil attribute, and Allah's is the loftiest attribute; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Those who do not believe in the life to come are evil examples. To God belongs all the exalted attributes; He is the Majestic and the All-wise.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil description, and for Allah is the highest description. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
english_translations.arberry: Those who believe not in the world to come, theirs is the evil likeness; God's is the loftiest likeness; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

ayahs.transliteration: walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa biẓul'mihim mā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ যদি মানুষকে তাদের সীমালঙ্ঘনের জন্য পাকড়াও করতেন, তাহলে যমীনের উপর কোন প্রাণীকেই তিনি রেহাই দিতেন না। কিন্তু তিনি একটা নির্দিষ্ট কাল পর্যন্ত তাদেরকে সময় দেন। তাদের সময় এসে গেলে এক মুহূর্তও অগ্র-পশ্চাৎ করা হয় না।
ayahs.translation_en: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
ayahs.conventional_en: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
ayahs.conventional_bn: যদি আল্লাহ মানুষকে তাদের জুলুমের জন্য পাকড়াও করতেন, তবে পৃথিবীতে কোনো প্রাণীই ছাড়তেন না; কিন্তু তিনি তাদেরকে একটি নির্দিষ্ট সময় পর্যন্ত অবকাশ দেন; অতঃপর যখন তাদের নির্ধারিত সময় আসে, তখন তারা এক মুহূর্তও পিছাতে বা এগোতে পারে না।

ayahs.meta_en: The Suspended Judgment & Fixed Term Limit
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; بِظُلْمِهِم (জন্যে তাদের বাড়াবাড়ির) — শব্দমূল [ظ ل م]: অন্ধকার সমূহের; সিস্টেমের সঠিক অবস্থান থেকে বিচ্যুত হয়ে অন্ধকার ও ধ্বংস ডেকে আনা।

english_translations.sahih_international: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
english_translations.pickthall: If Allah were to take mankind to task for their wrong-doing, he would not leave hereon a living creature, but He reprieveth them to an appointed term, and when their term cometh they cannot put (it) off an hour nor (yet) advance (it).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If Allah were to punish men for their wrong-doing, He would not leave, on the (earth), a single living creature: but He gives them respite for a stated Term: When their Term expires, they would not be able to delay (the punishment) for a single hour, just as they would not be able to anticipate it (for a single hour).
english_translations.shakir: And if Allah had destroyed men for their iniquity, He would not leave on the earth a single creature, but He respites them till an appointed time; so when their doom will come they shall not be able to delay (it) an hour nor can they bring (it) on (before its time).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Was God to seize people immediately for their injustice, no living creature would be left on earth. He gives them respite for an appointed time. When their term is over, they will not be able to change the inevitable.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And if Allah were to seize mankind for their wrong-doing, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving (living) creature, but He postpones them for an appointed term and when their term comes, neither can they delay nor can they advance it an hour (or a moment).
english_translations.arberry: If God should take men to task for their evildoing, He would not leave on the earth one creature that crawls; but He is deferring them to a term stated; and when their term is come they shall not put it back by a single hour nor put it forward.

ayahs.transliteration: wayajʿalūna lillahi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥus'nā lā jarama anna lahumu l-nāra wa-annahum muf'raṭūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা আল্লাহর জন্য তা-ই নির্ধারণ করে যা (নিজেদের জন্য) অপছন্দ করে, আর তাদের জিহবা মিথ্যা বলে যে, কল্যাণ তাদেরই জন্য। কোন সন্দেহ নেই যে, তাদের জন্য আছে আগুন আর সর্বপ্রথম তাদেরকেই সেখানে জলদি পৌঁছে দেয়া হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা আল্লাহর জন্য এমন জিনিস নির্ধারণ করে, যা তারা নিজেরা অপছন্দ করে; আর তাদের জিহ্বা মিথ্যা বর্ণনা করে যে, 'আমাদের জন্য কল্যাণ রয়েছে।' নিশ্চয় তাদের জন্য জাহান্নাম রয়েছে; এবং তারা অবশ্যই প্রেরিত হবে।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: لِلَّهِ (জন্যে আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; ٱلنَّارَ (আগুন) — শব্দমূল [ن و ر]: আগুন; উচ্চতাপীয় প্লাজমা, তীব্র তাপশক্তি ও থার্মোডাইনামিক দহন (Thermal Plasma & Combustion Energy)।

english_translations.sahih_international: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
english_translations.pickthall: And they assign unto Allah that which they (themselves) dislike, and their tongues expound the lie that the better portion will be theirs. Assuredly theirs will be the Fire, and they will be abandoned.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They attribute to Allah what they hate (for themselves), and their tongues assert the falsehood that all good things are for themselves: without doubt for them is the Fire, and they will be the first to be hastened on into it!
english_translations.shakir: And they ascribe to Allah what they (themselves) hate and their tongues relate the lie that they shall have the good; there is no avoiding it that for them is the fire and that they shall be sent before.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They ascribe to God that which even they themselves do not like and their lying tongues say that their end will be virtuous. Their share will certainly be hell fire to which they are earnestly heading.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: They assign to Allah that which they dislike (for themselves), and their tongues assert the falsehood that the better things will be theirs. No doubt for them is the Fire, and they will be the first to be hastened on into it, and left there neglected. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 10, Page 121)
english_translations.arberry: They assign to God that they themselves dislike; and their tongues describe falsehood, that the reward most fair shall be theirs. Without any doubt theirs shall be the Fire, and they are hastened in.

ayahs.transliteration: tal-lahi laqad arsalnā ilā umamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum ʿadhābun alīmun
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহর কসম! তোমার পূর্বে আমি বহু জাতির কাছে রসূল পাঠিয়েছিলাম, কিন্তু শয়ত্বান তাদের কাছে তাদের কার্যকলাপকে শোভনীয় করে দিয়েছিল, আর আজ সে-ই তাদের অভিভাবক, তাদের জন্য রয়েছে ভয়াবহ শাস্তি।
ayahs.translation_en: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.conventional_en: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহর শপথ! আমি তোমার পূর্ববর্তী উম্মতদের কাছে রাসূল প্রেরণ করেছিলাম; অতঃপর শয়তান তাদের কাজকে শোভনীয় করে দেখিয়েছিল; অতএব আজ সে তাদের বন্ধু; আর তাদের জন্য রয়েছে যন্ত্রণাদায়ক শাস্তি।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تَٱللَّهِ (শপথ আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; أَرْسَلْنَآ (আমরা পাঠিয়েছি) — শব্দমূল [ر س ل]: রাসূলদেরকে; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'রাসূলদেরকে'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
english_translations.pickthall: By Allah, We verily sent messengers unto the nations before thee, but the devil made their deeds fairseeming unto them. So he is their patron this day, and theirs will be a painful doom.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: By Allah, We (also) sent (Our messengers) to Peoples before thee; but Satan made, (to the wicked), their own acts seem alluring: He is also their patron today, but they shall have a most grievous penalty.
english_translations.shakir: By Allah, most certainly We sent (apostles) to nations before you, but the Shaitan made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so he is their guardian today, and they shall have a painful punishment.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: By God, We sent (Messengers) to nations who lived before you. Satan made their deeds seem attractive to them and, on the Day of Judgment, satan will be their guardian. For them there will be a painful punishment.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: By Allah, We indeed sent (Messengers) to the nations before you (O Muhammad SAW), but Shaitan (Satan) made their deeds fair-seeming to them. So he (Satan) is their Wali (helper) today (i.e. in this world), and theirs will be a painful torment.
english_translations.arberry: By God, assuredly We sent Messengers to nations before thee, but Satan decked out fair to them their deeds; he is their protector today, and there yet awaits them a painful chastisement.

ayahs.transliteration: wamā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu alladhī ikh'talafū fīhi wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমার প্রতি কিতাব এজন্য নাযিল করেছি যাতে তুমি সে সকল বিষয় স্পষ্ট করে দিতে পার যে বিষয়ে তারা মতভেদ করেছিল, আর (এ কিতাব) বিশ্বাসী সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য পথপ্রদর্শক ও রহমাত স্বরূপ।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি তোমার প্রতি কিতাব নাযিল করিনি — তবে যাতে তুমি তাদের কাছে সে বিষয় স্পষ্ট করো, যাতে তারা মতভেদ করছিল; এবং (এটি) পথপ্রদর্শন ও রহমত — সেই সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য, যারা ঈমান আনে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَهُدًۭى (এবং পথনির্দেশ) — শব্দমূল [ه د ي]: আমাদেরকে দেখান; অপ্টিমাইজড পথনির্দেশ, সত্যের আলো এবং জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ সঠিক অক্ষ।; وَرَحْمَةًۭ (ও দয়াস্বরূপ) — শব্দমূল [ر ح م]: পরম করুণাময়; মাতৃগর্ভের মতো পরম সুরক্ষাদায়ী মমতা, সর্বব্যাপী দয়া ও ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ যত্ন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
english_translations.pickthall: And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And We sent down the Book to thee for the express purpose, that thou shouldst make clear to them those things in which they differ, and that it should be a guide and a mercy to those who believe.
english_translations.shakir: And We have not revealed to you the Book except that you may make clear to them that about which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have sent you the Book for no other reason than to settle their differences and to be a guide and mercy for those who believe.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We have not sent down the Book (the Quran) to you (O Muhammad SAW), except that you may explain clearly unto them those things in which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a folk who believe.
english_translations.arberry: And We have not sent down upon thee the Book except that thou mayest make clear to them that whereon they were at variance, and as a guidance and as a mercy to a people who believe.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yasmaʿūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ আকাশ থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করেন, অতঃপর তার দ্বারা যমীনকে তার মৃত্যুর পর পুনরায় জীবিত করেন। এতে ঐ সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য বহু নিদর্শন আছে যারা লক্ষ্য করে শুনে।
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ আসমান থেকে পানি বর্ষণ করেন; অতঃপর তিনি তা দ্বারা পৃথিবীকে তার মৃত্যুর পর জীবন দান করেন; নিশ্চয় এতে শ্রবণকারী সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَٱللَّهُ (এবং আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; ٱلسَّمَآءِ (আকাশ) — শব্দমূল [س م و]: নামে; মহাজাগতিক স্তরবিন্যাস, মহাশূন্য, স্পেস-টাইম মেট্রিক ও বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় সপ্তস্তর (Atmospheric & Cosmic Stratification)।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
english_translations.pickthall: Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And Allah sends down rain from the skies, and gives therewith life to the earth after its death: verily in this is a Sign for those who listen.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has sent down water from the cloud and therewith given life to the earth after its death; most surely there is a sign in this for a people who would listen.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has sent down water from the sky and has brought the dead earth to life. In this there is evidence (of the truth) for those who listen (carefully).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah sends down water (rain) from the sky, then He revives the earth therewith after its death. Verily, in this is a sign (clear proof) for people who listen (obey Allah).
english_translations.arberry: And it is God who sends down out of heaven water, and therewith revives the earth after it is dead. Surely in that is a sign for a people who have ears.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sāighan lilshāribīna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাদের জন্য গবাদি পশুতেও অবশ্যই শিক্ষা নিহিত আছে। তোমাদেরকে পান করাই ওদের পেটের গোবর আর রক্তের মাঝ থেকে বিশুদ্ধ দুগ্ধ যা পানকারীদের জন্য খুবই উপাদেয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
ayahs.conventional_en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমাদের জন্য চতুষ্পদ জন্তুর মধ্যে রয়েছে শিক্ষণীয় বিষয়; আমি তোমাদের পান করাই — যা তাদের পেটের ভিতর আছে — গোবর ও রক্তের মধ্য থেকে বিশুদ্ধ দুধ, যা পানকারীদের জন্য সুস্বাদু।

ayahs.meta_en: The Biochemical Synthesis of Pure Milk
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ (গবাদিপশুর) — শব্দমূল [ن ع م]: আপনি অনুগ্রহ দান করেছেন; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'আপনি অনুগ্রহ দান করেছেন'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।; لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ (অবশ্যই শিক্ষা) — শব্দমূল [ع ب ر]: শিক্ষা অবশ্যই; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'শিক্ষা অবশ্যই'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
english_translations.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And verily in cattle (too) will ye find an instructive sign. From what is within their bodies between excretions and blood, We produce, for your drink, milk, pure and agreeable to those who drink it.
english_translations.shakir: And most surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle; We give you to drink of what is in their bellies-- from betwixt the feces and the blood-- pure milk, easy and agreeable to swallow for those who drink.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: There is a lesson for you to learn concerning cattle. We provide pleasant milk for you to drink within the delicate system of their veins and arteries.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And verily! In the cattle, there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from between excretions and blood, pure milk; palatable to the drinkers.
english_translations.arberry: And surely in the cattle there is a lesson for you; We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, between filth and blood, pure milk, sweet to drinkers.

ayahs.transliteration: wamin thamarāti l-nakhīli wal-aʿnābi tattakhidhūna min'hu sakaran wariz'qan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿqilūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর খেজুর ও আঙ্গুর ফল থেকে তোমরা মদ ও উত্তম খাদ্য প্রস্তুত কর, জ্ঞানী সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য এতে অবশ্যই বহু নিদর্শন রয়েছে।
ayahs.translation_en: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
ayahs.conventional_en: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর খেজুর ও আঙ্গুরের ফল থেকে তোমরা নেশা ও উত্তম জীবিকা গ্রহণ করো; নিশ্চয় এতে বোধসম্পন্ন সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ثَمَرَٰتِ (ফলগুলো) — শব্দমূল [ث م ر]: নানা ধরণের ফলমূল; উদ্ভিদের খাদ্যশক্তি ও ভিটামিন ঘনীভূত ফল, যা বংশবৃদ্ধির বীজকে পুষ্টি ও সুরক্ষা দেয়।; يَعْقِلُونَ ((যারা) জ্ঞান রাখে) — শব্দমূল [ع ق ل]: তোমরা বুঝ; বুদ্ধিবৃত্তি, লজিক্যাল প্রসেসিং, কার্যকারণ সম্পর্ক অনুধাবন ও আবেগ সংযত করার মানসিক শক্তি।

english_translations.sahih_international: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
english_translations.pickthall: And of the fruits of the date-palm, and grapes, whence ye derive strong drink and (also) good nourishment. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who have sense.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And from the fruit of the date-palm and the vine, ye get out wholesome drink and food: behold, in this also is a sign for those who are wise.
english_translations.shakir: And of the fruits of the palms and the grapes-- you obtain from them intoxication and goodly provision; most surely there is a sign in this for a people who ponder.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The fruit of palm trees and vines which provide you with sugar and delicious food also provide a lesson and evidence (of the Truth) for the people of understanding.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And from the fruits of date-palms and grapes, you derive strong drink (this was before the order of the prohibition of the alcoholic drinks) and a goodly provision. Verily, therein is indeed a sign for people who have wisdom.
english_translations.arberry: And of the fruits of the palms and the vines, you take therefrom an intoxicant and a provision fair. Surely in that is a sign for a people who understand.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-awḥā rabbuka ilā l-naḥli ani ittakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina l-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালক মৌমাছির প্রতি এলহাম করেছেন যে, পাহাড়ে, বৃক্ষে আর উঁচু চালে বাসা তৈরি কর।
ayahs.translation_en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
ayahs.conventional_en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমার রব মৌমাছির কাছে ওহী পাঠালেন যে, 'তুমি পাহাড়ে, গাছে এবং তারা যে উঁচু আশ্রয় তৈরি করে, সেখানে ঘর বানাও।'

ayahs.meta_en: The Instinctual Coding of the Honeybee
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلنَّحْلِ (মৌমাছির) — শব্দমূল [ن ح ل]: স্বতঃপ্রবৃত্ত হয়ে; মৌমাছি, যার জটিল জ্যামিতিক চাক ও হাইভ কমিউনিকেশন প্রাকৃতিক ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিংয়ের বিস্ময়।; ٱلْجِبَالِ (পাহাড়গুলোর) — শব্দমূল [ج ب ل]: পাহাড়ের; ভূত্বকের শিকড় (Roots of Mountains), টেকটনিক প্লেটের স্থিতিশীলতা ও আইসোস্ট্যাটিক ভারসাম্য।

english_translations.sahih_international: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
english_translations.pickthall: And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And thy Lord taught the Bee to build its cells in hills, on trees, and in (men's) habitations;
english_translations.shakir: And your Lord revealed to the bee saying: Make hives in the mountains and in the trees and in what they build:
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord inspired the bees, "Make hives in the mountains, in the trees and in the trellises,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And your Lord inspired the bee, saying: "Take you habitations in the mountains and in the trees and in what they erect.
english_translations.arberry: And thy Lord revealed unto the bees, saying: 'Take unto yourselves, of the mountains, houses, and of the trees, and of what they are building.

ayahs.transliteration: thumma kulī min kulli l-thamarāti fa-us'lukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukh'talifun alwānuhu fīhi shifāon lilnnāsi inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর প্রত্যেক ফল থেকে আহার কর, অতঃপর তোমার প্রতিপালকের (শিখানো) সহজ পদ্ধতি অনুসরণ কর। এর পেট থেকে রং-বেরং এর পানীয় বের হয়। এতে মানুষের জন্য আছে আরোগ্য। চিন্তাশীল মানুষের জন্য এতে অবশ্যই নিদর্শন আছে।
ayahs.translation_en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.conventional_bn: 'অতঃপর তুমি সকল প্রকার ফল থেকে খাও; অতঃপর তোমার রবের সুগম পথে চলো।' তাদের পেট থেকে বিভিন্ন রঙের পানীয় বের হয়; তাতে মানুষের জন্য রয়েছে আরোগ্য; নিশ্চয় এতে চিন্তাশীল সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ (ফলসমূহ) — শব্দমূল [ث م ر]: নানা ধরণের ফলমূল; উদ্ভিদের খাদ্যশক্তি ও ভিটামিন ঘনীভূত ফল, যা বংশবৃদ্ধির বীজকে পুষ্টি ও সুরক্ষা দেয়।; يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ((যারা) চিন্তা ভাবনা করে) — শব্দমূল [ف ك ر]: চিন্তা-ভাবনা করবে; মহাবিশ্ব ও প্রকৃতির নিদর্শন নিয়ে গভীর মননশীল গবেষণা ও চিন্তাভাবনা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
english_translations.pickthall: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Then to eat of all the produce (of the earth), and find with skill the spacious paths of its Lord: there issues from within their bodies a drink of varying colours, wherein is healing for men: verily in this is a Sign for those who give thought.
english_translations.shakir: Then eat of all the fruits and walk in the ways of your Lord submissively. There comes forth from within it a beverage of many colours, in which there is healing for men; most surely there is a sign in this for a people who reflect.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: then eat of every fruit and follow the path of your Lord submissively." From out of their bellies comes a drink of different color in which there is a cure for the human being. In this there is evidence (of the truth) for the people of understanding.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Then, eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of your Lord made easy (for you)." There comes forth from their bellies, a drink of varying colour wherein is healing for men. Verily, in this is indeed a sign for people who think.
english_translations.arberry: Then eat of all manner of fruit, and follow the ways of your Lord easy to go upon.' Then comes there forth out of their bellies a drink of diverse hues wherein is healing for men. Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likay lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿil'min shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun qadīrun
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ্ই তোমাদেরকে পয়দা করেছেন, অতঃপর তিনি তোমাদের মৃত্যু ঘটাবেন। তোমাদের কাউকে অকর্মণ্য বয়সে ফিরিয়ে দেয়া হয়, যাতে জ্ঞান লাভ করার পরেও আর কোন কিছুর জ্ঞান থাকে না। আল্লাহ সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ জ্ঞানী, সর্বাপেক্ষা শক্তিমান।

words.translation_en: He takes your souls at death

ayahs.translation_en: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তোমাদের সৃষ্টি করেছেন; অতঃপর তিনি তোমাদের মৃত্যু দান করেন; আর তোমাদের মধ্যে কেউ কেউ বয়সের নিকৃষ্ট পর্যায়ে ফিরিয়ে দেওয়া হয়, যাতে জ্ঞানের পর কিছুই জানতে না পারে; নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ সর্বজ্ঞ, সর্বশক্তিমান।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَٱللَّهُ (এবং আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; خَلَقَكُمْ (সৃষ্টি করেছেন তোমাদের) — শব্দমূল [خ ل ق]: তোমাদের সৃষ্টি করেছেন; পরম নিখুঁত নকশা ও অনুপাত অনুযায়ী শূন্য থেকে নবসৃষ্টি রূপায়ণ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah createth you, then causeth you to die, and among you is he who is brought back to the most abject stage of life, so that he knoweth nothing after (having had) knowledge. Lo! Allah is Knower, Powerful.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is Allah who creates you and takes your souls at death; and of you there are some who are sent back to a feeble age, so that they know nothing after having known (much): for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has created you, then He causes you to die, and of you is he who is brought back to the worst part of life, so that after having knowledge he does not know anything; surely Allah is Knowing, Powerful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has created you and He causes you to die. Some of you will grow to an extremely old age and lose your memory. God is All-knowing and Almighty.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has created you and then He will cause you to die, and of you there are some who are sent back to senility, so that they know nothing after having known (much). Truly! Allah is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
english_translations.arberry: God created you; then He will gather you to Him; and some of you will be kept back unto the vilest state of life, that after knowing somewhat, they may know nothing; God is All-knowing, All-powerful.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-riz'qi famā alladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī riz'qihim ʿalā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāon afabiniʿ'mati l-lahi yajḥadūna
ayahs.translation_bn: রিযকের ব্যাপারে আল্লাহ তোমাদের মধ্যে কাউকে কারো উপর প্রাধান্য দিয়েছেন। যাদেরকে প্রাধান্য দেয়া হয়েছে তারা তাদের রিযক থেকে তাদের অধীনস্থ চাকর- গোলামদেরকে এমনভাবে ফিরিয়ে দেয় না, যাতে এক্ষেত্রে তারা সমান হয়ে যায়। (অথচ তারা নানান কিছুকে আল্লাহর অংশীদার বানিয়ে ওগুলোকে আল্লাহর সমান করে ফেলছে) তাহলে কি তারা আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহ অস্বীকার করে?

words.translation_en: Then is it the favor of

ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তোমাদের কারও কারও ওপর রিজিকে অগ্রাধিকার দিয়েছেন; অতএব যাদের অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হয়েছে, তারা তাদের অধীনস্থদের ওপর নিজেদের রিজিক ফিরিয়ে দেয় না, যাতে তারা এতে সমান হয়; তবে কি তারা আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহকে অস্বীকার করে?

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah hath favoured some of you above others in provision. Now those who are more favoured will by no means hand over their provision to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Is it then the grace of Allah that they deny?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Allah has bestowed His gifts of sustenance more freely on some of you than on others: those more favoured are not going to throw back their gifts to those whom their right hands possess, so as to be equal in that respect. Will they then deny the favours of Allah?
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has made some of you excel others in the means of subsistence, so those who are made to excel do not give away their sustenance to those whom their right hands possess so that they should be equal therein; is it then the favor of Allah which they deny?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has made some of you richer than others. The rich ones do not have to give away their property to their slaves to make them equally rich. Do they reject the bounties of God?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has preferred some of you above others in wealth and properties. Then, those who are preferred will by no means hand over their wealth and properties to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Do they then deny the Favour of Allah?
english_translations.arberry: And God has preferred some of you over others in provision;, but those that were preferred shall not give over their provision to that their right hands possess, so that they may be equal therein. What, and do they deny God's blessing?

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wajaʿala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabiniʿ'mati l-lahi hum yakfurūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ তোমাদের স্বজাতির মধ্য হতেই তোমাদের জোড়া সৃষ্টি করেছেন আর তোমাদের জন্য তোমাদের জোড়া থেকে পুত্র-পৌত্রাদি বানিয়েছেন আর তোমাদেরকে উৎকৃষ্ট রিযক দিয়েছেন। তবুও কি তারা ভিত্তিহীন বাতিল জিনিসের উপর ঈমান পোষণ করবে আর আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহকে তারা অস্বীকার করবে?
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তোমাদের জন্য তোমাদের নিজেদের থেকে স্ত্রী সৃষ্টি করেছেন; এবং তোমাদের স্ত্রীদের থেকে তোমাদের জন্য পুত্র ও নাতি-নাতনি দিয়েছেন; এবং তোমাদের উত্তম বস্তু থেকে রিজিক দিয়েছেন; তবে কি তারা মিথ্যে বিশ্বাস করে এবং আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহ অস্বীকার করে?
