english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And Allah has made for you mates (and companions) of your own nature, and made for you, out of them, sons and daughters and grandchildren, and provided for you sustenance of the best: will they then believe in vain things, and be ungrateful for Allah's favours?-
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has made wives for you from among yourselves, and has given you sons and grandchildren from your wives, and has given you of the good things; is it then in the falsehood that they believe while it is in the favor of Allah that they disbelieve?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has created spouses for you from your own selves. He has created your sons and grandsons from your spouses and has given you pure things for your sustenance. Do they then believe in falsehood and reject the bounties of God?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has made for you wives of your own kind, and has made for you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and has bestowed on you good provision. Do they then believe in false deities and deny the Favour of Allah (by not worshipping Allah Alone).
english_translations.arberry: God has appointed for you of yourselves wives, and He has appointed for you of your wives sons and grandsons, and He has provided you of the good things. What, do they believe in vanity, and do they disbelieve in God's blessing?

ayahs.transliteration: wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yamliku lahum riz'qan mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi shayan walā yastaṭīʿūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আর আল্লাহকে বাদ দিয়ে ‘ইবাদাত করবে অন্যের যারা আকাশ ও যমীন থেকে তাদের জন্য রিযক দেয়ার মালিক নয়, আর তারা এ কাজে সক্ষমও নয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা আল্লাহকে ছাড়া এমন জিনিসের উপাসনা করে, যা তাদের আসমানসমূহ ও জমিন থেকে কোনো রিজিক দিতে পারে না; এবং তারা (তা) করতে পারে না।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ (আল্লাহর (অন্য কিছুকে)) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; يَمْلِكُ (ক্ষমতা রাখে) — শব্দমূল [م ل ك]: মহাজাগতিক মৌলিক প্রাকৃতিক বলসমূহ ও কোয়ান্টাম চালিকাশক্তি; মহাবিশ্বের সমস্ত দৃশ্য-অদৃশ্য রাজত্ব ও সিস্টেমের ওপর অখণ্ড নিরঙ্কুশ সার্বভৌমত্ব।

english_translations.sahih_international: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
english_translations.pickthall: And they worship beside Allah that which owneth no provision whatsoever for them from the heavens or the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And worship others than Allah,- such as have no power of providing them, for sustenance, with anything in heavens or earth, and cannot possibly have such power?
english_translations.shakir: And they serve besides Allah that which does not control for them any sustenance at all from the heavens and the earth, nor have they any power.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do they worship things other than God which neither provide them with any sustenance from the heavens and the earth nor have the ability to do so?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they worship others besides Allah, such as do not and cannot own any provision for them from the heavens or the earth.
english_translations.arberry: And do they serve, apart from God, that which has no power to provide them anything from the heavens and the earth and can do nothing?

ayahs.transliteration: falā taḍribū lillahi l-amthāla inna l-laha yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই কারো সাথে আল্লাহর তুলনা দিও না। আল্লাহ জানেন, আর তোমরা জান না।
ayahs.translation_en: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_en: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতএব তোমরা আল্লাহর জন্য দৃষ্টান্ত স্থাপন করো না; নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ জানেন, আর তোমরা জানো না।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: لِلَّهِ (জন্যে আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; تَضْرِبُوا۟ (তোমরা বর্ণনা করো) — শব্দমূল [ض ر ب]: তিনি পেশ করবেন; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'তিনি পেশ করবেন'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: So coin not similitudes for Allah. Lo! Allah knoweth; ye know not.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Invent not similitudes for Allah: for Allah knoweth, and ye know not.
english_translations.shakir: Therefore do not give likenesses to Allah; surely Allah knows and you do not know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not consider anything equal to God. God knows that which you do not know.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So put not forward similitudes for Allah (as there is nothing similar to Him, nor He resembles anything). Truly! Allah knows and you know not.
english_translations.arberry: So strike not any similitudes for God; surely God knows, and you know not.

ayahs.transliteration: ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan ʿabdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin waman razaqnāhu minnā riz'qan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu min'hu sirran wajahran hal yastawūna l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ দৃষ্টান্ত দিচ্ছেনঃ অন্যের মালিকানাভুক্ত এক দাস যে কোন কিছু করারই ক্ষমতা রাখে না। আর এক লোক যাকে আমি আমার পক্ষ হতে উত্তম জীবিকা দান করেছি আর তাত্থেকে সে গোপনে প্রকাশ্যে দান করে, (এ) দু’জন কি সমান? সমস্ত প্রশংসা আল্লাহরই জন্য, কিন্তু তাদের অধিকাংশই জানে না।
ayahs.translation_en: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.conventional_en: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহ একটি দৃষ্টান্ত দিয়েছেন — একটি অধীনস্থ ক্রীতদাস, যে কোনো কিছুর ক্ষমতা রাখে না; এবং আরেকজন, যাকে আমি আমার পক্ষ থেকে উত্তম রিজিক দিয়েছি, আর সে তা থেকে গোপনে ও প্রকাশ্যে ব্যয় করে; তারা কি সমান? সকল প্রশংসা আল্লাহর জন্য; বরং তাদের অধিকাংশই জানে না।

ayahs.meta_en: The Parable of the Helpless Slave vs Sovereign Donor
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; مَّمْلُوكًۭا (অপরের অধিকারভুক্ত) — শব্দমূল [م ل ك]: মহাজাগতিক মৌলিক প্রাকৃতিক বলসমূহ ও কোয়ান্টাম চালিকাশক্তি; মহাবিশ্বের সমস্ত দৃশ্য-অদৃশ্য রাজত্ব ও সিস্টেমের ওপর অখণ্ড নিরঙ্কুশ সার্বভৌমত্ব।

english_translations.sahih_international: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.
english_translations.pickthall: Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing, and (on the other hand) one on whom we have bestowed a fair provision from Us, and he spendeth thereof secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Allah sets forth the Parable (of two men: one) a slave under the dominion of another; He has no power of any sort; and (the other) a man on whom We have bestowed goodly favours from Ourselves, and he spends thereof (freely), privately and publicly: are the two equal? (By no means;) praise be to Allah. But most of them understand not.
english_translations.shakir: Allah sets forth a parable: (consider) a slave, the property of another, (who) has no power over anything, and one whom We have granted from Ourselves a goodly sustenance so he spends from it secretly and openly; are the two alike? (All) praise is due to Allah! Nay, most of them do not know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God tells a parable about a helpless servant and one to whom He has given honorable provisions and who has spent for the cause of God privately and in public. Can these two people be considered equal? It is only God who deserves all praise, but most people do not know.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Allah puts forward the example (of two men a believer and a disbeliever); a slave (disbeliever) under the possession of another, he has no power of any sort, and (the other), a man (believer) on whom We have bestowed a good provision from Us, and He spends thereof secretly and openly. Can they be equal? (By no means, not). All the praises and thanks be to Allah. Nay! (But) most of them know not.
english_translations.arberry: God has struck a similitude: a servant possessed by his master, having no power over anything, and one whom We have provided of Ourselves with a provision fair, and he expends of it secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise belongs to God! Nay, most of them know not.

ayahs.transliteration: waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shayin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhu lā yati bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman yamuru bil-ʿadli wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ আরো দৃষ্টান্ত দিচ্ছেন দু’ব্যক্তির তাদের একজন হল বোবা, কোন কিছুই করতে সক্ষম নয়। তার মনিবের উপর সে একটা বোঝা, তাকে যেখানেই পাঠানো হোক না কেন, কোন কল্যাণই সে নিয়ে আসবে না। সে কি ঐ ব্যক্তির সমান যে ইনসাফের নির্দেশ দেয় আর সরল সুদৃঢ় পথে প্রতিষ্ঠিত?
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ দুই ব্যক্তির দৃষ্টান্ত দিয়েছেন — তাদের একজন বোবা, যে কোনো কিছুর ক্ষমতা রাখে না; সে তার ওপর নির্ভরশীল; সে যেদিকে পাঠায়, সেখান থেকে কোনো কল্যাণ আসে না; সে কি তার সমান, যে ইনসাফের আদেশ দেয় এবং সোজা পথে আছে?

ayahs.meta_en: The Parable of the Mute Burden vs Upholder of Justice
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهُ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; يَقْدِرُ (ক্ষমতা রাখে) — শব্দমূল [ق د ر]: সর্বশক্তিমান; মহাবিশ্বের পরম সুনির্দিষ্ট গাণিতিক পরিমাপ, ভৌত ধ্রুবক ও সুসংহত পূর্বনির্ধারিত নিয়ম।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah coineth a similitude: Two men, one of them dumb, having control of nothing, and he is a burden on his owner; whithersoever he directeth him to go, he bringeth no good. Is he equal with one who enjoineth justice and followeth a straight path (of conduct)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Allah sets forth (another) Parable of two men: one of them dumb, with no power of any sort; a wearisome burden is he to his master; whichever way be directs him, he brings no good: is such a man equal with one who commands Justice, and is on a Straight Way?
english_translations.shakir: And Allah sets forth a parable of two men; one of them is dumb, not able to do anything, and he is a burden to his master; wherever he sends him, he brings no good; can he be held equal with him who enjoins what is just, and he (himself) is on the right path?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God tells a parable about two men. One of them is dumb and useless and a burden on his friend. Wherever he goes, he returns with nothing. Can he be considered equal to the one who maintains justice and follows the right path?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah puts forward (another) example of two men, one of them dumb, who has no power over anything (disbeliever), and he is a burden to his master, whichever way he directs him, he brings no good. Is such a man equal to one (believer in the Islamic Monotheism) who commands justice, and is himself on a Straight Path?
english_translations.arberry: God has struck a similitude: two men, one of them dumb, having no power over anything, and he is a burden upon his master -- wherever he despatches him, he brings no good. Is he equal to him who bids to justice, and is on a straight path?

ayahs.transliteration: walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru l-sāʿati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
ayahs.translation_bn: আকাশসমূহ ও যমীনের অদৃশ্যের জ্ঞান কেবল আল্লাহরই আছে। ক্বিয়ামাতের ব্যাপার তো চোখের পলকের মত বরং তাত্থেকেও দ্রুত। আল্লাহ সব কিছু করতেই সক্ষম।
ayahs.translation_en: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
ayahs.conventional_en: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আসমানসমূহ ও জমিনের অদৃশ্য জ্ঞান আল্লাহরই; আর কিয়ামতের বিষয় তো চোখের পলকের মতো, বরং তার চেয়েও নিকটবর্তী; নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ সবকিছুর ওপর ক্ষমতাবান।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَلِلَّهِ (এবং আল্লাহরই আছে) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ (আকাশমন্ডলীর) — শব্দমূল [س م و]: নামে; মহাজাগতিক স্তরবিন্যাস, মহাশূন্য, স্পেস-টাইম মেট্রিক ও বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় সপ্তস্তর (Atmospheric & Cosmic Stratification)।

english_translations.sahih_international: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
english_translations.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and the matter of the Hour (of Doom) is but as a twinkling of the eye, or it is nearer still. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To Allah belongeth the Mystery of the heavens and the earth. And the Decision of the Hour (of Judgment) is as the twingkling of an eye, or even quicker: for Allah hath power over all things.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah's is the unseen of the heavens and the earth; and the matter of the hour is but as the twinkling of an eye or it is higher still; surely Allah has power over all things.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: To God belongs all the secrets of the heavens and the earth. It only takes God a twinkling of an eye or even less to make it the Day of Judgment. God has power over all things.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth. And the matter of the Hour is not but as a twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. Truly! Allah is Able to do all things.
english_translations.arberry: To God belongs the Unseen in the heavens and in the earth. And the matter of the Hour is as a twinkling of the eye, or nearer. Surely God is powerful over everything.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayan wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata laʿallakum tashkurūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ তোমাদেরকে তোমাদের মায়ের পেট থেকে বের করেন, তোমরা কিছুই জানতে না। তিনি তোমাদেরকে শোনার শক্তি, দেখার শক্তি আর অন্তর দান করেছেন যাতে তোমরা শোকর আদায় করতে পার।
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তোমাদেরকে তোমাদের মায়ের গর্ভ থেকে বের করেছেন — তোমরা কিছুই জানতে না — আর তিনি তোমাদের জন্য শ্রবণ, দৃষ্টি ও অন্তর সৃষ্টি করেছেন; যাতে তোমরা কৃতজ্ঞ হও।
ayahs.meta_bn: গর্ভ থেকে নিষ্কাশন ও ইন্দ্রিয় সৃষ্টি

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَٱللَّهُ (এবং আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; ٱلسَّمْعَ (শ্রবণশক্তিসমূহ) — শব্দমূল [س م ع]: তাদের শ্রবণশক্তির; শ্রবণেন্দ্রিয়, অন্তঃকর্ণের কক্লিয়া, শ্রবণ স্নায়ু ও অডিটরি কর্টেক্স (ভ্রূণে প্রথম বিকশিত অনুভূতি)।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is He Who brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers when ye knew nothing; and He gave you hearing and sight and intelligence and affections: that ye may give thanks (to Allah).
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers-- you did not know anything-- and He gave you hearing and sight and hearts that you may give thanks.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When God brought you out of your mothers wombs, you knew nothing. He gave you ears, eyes, and hearts so that perhaps you would give Him thanks.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has brought you out from the wombs of your mothers while you know nothing. And He gave you hearing, sight, and hearts that you might give thanks (to Allah).
english_translations.arberry: And it is God who brought you forth from your mothers' wombs, and He appointed for you hearing, and sight, and hearts, that haply so you will be thankful.

ayahs.transliteration: alam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri musakharātin fī jawwi l-samāi mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-lahu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আকাশের শূন্যলোকে নিয়ন্ত্রিত পাখীগুলোর প্রতি কি তারা লক্ষ্য করে না? আল্লাহ ছাড়া কেউ তাদেরকে স্থির রাখে না, এতে মু’মিন সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য অবশ্যই বহু নিদর্শন রয়েছে।
ayahs.translation_en: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_en: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা কি পাখিদের দেখে না — তারা আকাশের বাতাসে অনুগতভাবে উড়ে? আল্লাহ ছাড়া কেউ তাদের ধরে রাখে না; নিশ্চয় এতে বিশ্বাসী সম্প্রদায়ের জন্য নিদর্শন রয়েছে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱلطَّيْرِ ((উড়ন্ত) পাখীগুলোর) — শব্দমূল [ط ي ر]: পাখি; বায়ুর প্রবাহে ডানা প্রসারিত ও সংকুচিত করে বায়ুমণ্ডলে পাখির ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ উড্ডয়ন।; ٱلسَّمَآءِ (আকাশের) — শব্দমূল [س م و]: নামে; মহাজাগতিক স্তরবিন্যাস, মহাশূন্য, স্পেস-টাইম মেট্রিক ও বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় সপ্তস্তর (Atmospheric & Cosmic Stratification)।

english_translations.sahih_international: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
english_translations.pickthall: Have they not seen the birds obedient in mid-air? None holdeth them save Allah. Lo! herein, verily, are portents for a people who believe.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do they not look at the birds, held poised in the midst of (the air and) the sky? Nothing holds them up but (the power of) Allah. Verily in this are signs for those who believe.
english_translations.shakir: Do they not see the birds, constrained in the middle of the sky? None withholds them but Allah; most surely there are signs in this for a people who believe.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Have you not considered the free movements of the birds high in the sky above? What keeps them aloft except God? In this there is evidence (of the truth) for the believing people.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Do they not see the birds held (flying) in the midst of the sky? None holds them but Allah [none gave them the ability to fly but Allah]. Verily, in this are clear proofs and signs for people who believe (in the Oneness of Allah).
english_translations.arberry: Have they not regarded the birds, that are subjected in the air of heaven? Naught holds them but God; surely in that are signs for' a people who believe.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum min julūdi l-anʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā athāthan wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ তোমাদের গৃহগুলোকে তোমাদের আরাম শান্তির জায়গা বানিয়ে দিয়েছেন। তিনি পশুর চামড়া থেকে তোমাদের জন্য এমন গৃহের ব্যবস্থা করেছেন যা তোমরা হালকাবোধ কর তোমাদের ভ্রমণকালে কিংবা অবস্থানকালে। তিনি ওগুলোর পশম, লোম আর চুল থেকে তোমাদের পরিধেয় ও ব্যবহার্য সামগ্রীর ব্যবস্থা করেছেন যা তোমরা কিছুকাল পর্যন্ত কাজে লাগাও।
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তোমাদের ঘরকে তোমাদের জন্য আবাসস্থল করেছেন; এবং চতুষ্পদ জন্তুর চামড়া থেকে তোমাদের জন্য ঘর তৈরি করেছেন — যা তোমরা ভ্রমণের দিন ও অবস্থানের দিন হালকা মনে করো; এবং তাদের পশম, লোম ও কেশ থেকে আসবাব ও জীবনোপকরণ — কিছুকাল পর্যন্ত।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَٱللَّهُ (এবং আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; جُلُودِ (চামড়াগুলোকে) — শব্দমূল [ج ل د]: চামড়া গুলো তাদের; ত্বক ও বহিঃত্বক লেয়ার, ব্যথাবহনকারী সংবেদনশীল রিসেপ্টর স্নায়ুপ্রান্ত (Nociceptors)।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is Allah Who made your habitations homes of rest and quiet for you; and made for you, out of the skins of animals, (tents for) dwellings, which ye find so light (and handy) when ye travel and when ye stop (in your travels); and out of their wool, and their soft fibres (between wool and hair), and their hair, rich stuff and articles of convenience (to serve you) for a time.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has given you a place to abide in your houses, and He has given you tents of the skins of cattle which you find light to carry on the day of your march and on the day of your halting, and of their wool and their fur and their hair (He has given you) household stuff and a provision for a time.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has made your house the place for you to rest. He has also made homes for you out of the skins of cattle which are easy to carry along on a journey or at a camp. He has made wool, fur and the hair of cattle a temporary means of enjoyment for you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has made for you in your homes an abode, and made for you out of the hides of the cattle (tents for) dwelling, which you find so light (and handy) when you travel and when you stay (in your travels), and of their wool, fur, and hair (sheep wool, camel fur, and goat hair), a furnishing and articles of convenience (e.g. carpets, blankets, etc.), a comfort for a while.
english_translations.arberry: And it is God who has appointed a place of rest for you of your houses, and He has appointed for you of the skins of the cattle houses you find light on the day that you journey, and on the day you abide, and of their wool, and of their fur, and of their hair furnishing and an enjoyment for a while.

ayahs.transliteration: wal-lahu jaʿala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥara wasarābīla taqīkum basakum kadhālika yutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tus'limūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ যা সৃষ্টি করেছেন তাত্থেকে তোমাদের জন্য ছায়ার ব্যবস্থা করেছেন, পাহাড়-পর্বতে তোমাদের আত্মগোপনের জায়গা বানিয়েছেন। তিনি তোমাদের জন্য পোশাক দিয়েছেন যা তোমাদেরকে তাপ থেকে রক্ষা করে। আর দিয়েছেন এমন পোশাক যা তোমাদেরকে সংঘাতের সময় রক্ষা করে। এভাবে তিনি তোমাদের জন্য তাঁর নি‘মাতসমূহ পূর্ণ করেন যাতে তোমরা তাঁর প্রতি আত্মসমর্পণ কর।
ayahs.translation_en: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ তাঁর সৃষ্ট জিনিস থেকে তোমাদের জন্য ছায়া তৈরি করেছেন; এবং পাহাড়ে তোমাদের জন্য গুহা তৈরি করেছেন; এবং তোমাদের জন্য এমন পোশাক তৈরি করেছেন, যা তোমাদের গরম থেকে রক্ষা করে; এবং এমন পোশাক, যা তোমাদের যুদ্ধ থেকে রক্ষা করে। এভাবেই তিনি তোমাদের ওপর তাঁর অনুগ্রহ সম্পূর্ণ করেন — যাতে তোমরা আত্মসমর্পণ করো।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَٱللَّهُ (এবং আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; خَلَقَ (তিনি সৃষ্টি করেছেন) — শব্দমূল [خ ل ق]: তোমাদের সৃষ্টি করেছেন; পরম নিখুঁত নকশা ও অনুপাত অনুযায়ী শূন্য থেকে নবসৃষ্টি রূপায়ণ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
english_translations.pickthall: And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is Allah Who made out of the things He created, some things to give you shade; of the hills He made some for your shelter; He made you garments to protect you from heat, and coats of mail to protect you from your (mutual) violence. Thus does He complete His favours on you, that ye may bow to His Will (in Islam).
english_translations.shakir: And Allah has made for you of what He has created shelters, and He has given you in the mountains places of retreat, and He has given you garments to preserve you from the heat and coats of mail to preserve you in your fighting; even thus does He complete His favor upon you, that haply you may submit.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God has provided shade for you out of what He has created and places of retreat out of mountains. He has given you garments to protect you from the heat and cover your private parts. This is how He perfects His bounties to you so that perhaps you would submit to His will.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah has made for you out of that which He has created shades, and has made for you places of refuge in the mountains, and has made for you garments to protect you from the heat (and cold), and coats of mail to protect you from your (mutual) violence. Thus does He perfect His Grace unto you, that you may submit yourselves to His Will (in Islam).
english_translations.arberry: And it is God who has appointed for you coverings of the things He created, and He has appointed for you of the mountains refuges, and He has appointed for you shirts to protect you from the heat, and shirts to protect you from your own violence. Even so He perfects His blessing upon you, that haply you will surrender.

ayahs.transliteration: fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu l-mubīnu
ayahs.translation_bn: এরপরও যদি তারা মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয় তবে (জোরপূর্বক তাদেরকে সঠিক পথে আনা তোমার দায়িত্ব নয়) তোমার দায়িত্ব কেবল স্পষ্টভাবে বাণী পৌঁছে দেয়া।
ayahs.translation_en: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
ayahs.conventional_en: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতএব যদি তারা মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়, তবে তোমার দায়িত্ব তো কেবল সুস্পষ্ট বার্তা পৌঁছে দেওয়া।

english_translations.sahih_international: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
english_translations.pickthall: Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But if they turn away, thy duty is only to preach the clear Message.
english_translations.shakir: But if they turn back, then on you devolves only the clear deliverance (of the message).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), if they turn away, your only duty is to clearly preach to them.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Then, if they turn away, your duty (O Muhammad SAW) is only to convey (the Message) in a clear way.

ayahs.transliteration: yaʿrifūna niʿ'mata l-lahi thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu l-kāfirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা আল্লাহর নি‘মাতকে চিনতে পারে, কিন্তু তা সত্ত্বেও সেগুলো অগ্রাহ্য করে, তাদের অধিকাংশই অকৃতজ্ঞ।
ayahs.translation_en: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
ayahs.conventional_en: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা আল্লাহর অনুগ্রহ চিনতে পারে; অতঃপর তারা তা অস্বীকার করে; আর তাদের অধিকাংশই কাফির।

english_translations.sahih_international: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
english_translations.pickthall: They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They recognise the favours of Allah; then they deny them; and most of them are (creatures) ungrateful.
english_translations.shakir: They recognize the favor of Allah, yet they deny it, and most of them are ungrateful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They recognize the bounties of God but they refuse them and most of them are unbelievers.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: They recognise the Grace of Allah, yet they deny it (by worshipping others besides Allah) and most of them are disbelievers (deny the Prophethood of Muhammad SAW).
english_translations.arberry: They recognize the blessing of God, then they deny it, and the most of them are the unthankful.

ayahs.transliteration: wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yus'taʿtabūna
ayahs.translation_bn: (সেদিন কী অবস্থা হবে) যেদিন আমি প্রত্যেক সম্প্রদায় থেকে একজন সাক্ষী দাঁড় করাব আর কাফিরদেরকে (কোন অযুহাত পেশ করার) অনুমতি দেয়া হবে না, আর ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করারও সুযোগ দেয়া হবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
ayahs.conventional_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যেদিন আমি প্রত্যেক উম্মত থেকে একজন সাক্ষী উত্থাপন করব; অতঃপর কাফিরদের অনুমতি দেওয়া হবে না; এবং তাদের ক্ষমা চাওয়ার সুযোগও দেওয়া হবে না।
ayahs.meta_bn: সাক্ষী উত্থাপন ও ক্ষমার সুযোগ রহিতকরণ

english_translations.sahih_international: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
english_translations.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: One Day We shall raise from all Peoples a Witness: then will no excuse be accepted from Unbelievers, nor will they receive any favours.
english_translations.shakir: And on the day when We will raise up a witness out of every nation, then shall no permission be given to those who disbelieve, nor shall they be made to solicit favor.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when We will call a witness from every nation, the disbelievers will not be given permission for anything, nor will they be allowed to seek solicitation.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when We shall raise up from each nation a witness (their Messenger), then, those who have disbelieved will not be given leave (to put forward excuses), nor will they be allowed (to return to the world) to repent and ask for Allah's Forgiveness (of their sins, etc.).
english_translations.arberry: And the day We shall raise up from every nation a witness, then to the unbelievers no leave shall be given, nor shall they be suffered to make amends.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā raā alladhīna ẓalamū l-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: সীমালঙ্ঘনকারীরা যখন ‘আযাব প্রত্যক্ষ করবে তাদের থেকে তখন তা কমানো হবে না, আর তাদেরকে সময়-সুযোগও দেয়া হবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.conventional_en: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন জালিমরা শাস্তি দেখবে, তখন তাদের থেকে তা হ্রাস করা হবে না; এবং তাদের অবকাশও দেওয়া হবে না।

english_translations.sahih_international: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
english_translations.pickthall: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When the wrong-doers (actually) see the Penalty, then will it in no way be mitigated, nor will they then receive respite.
english_translations.shakir: And when those who are unjust shall see the chastisement, it shall not be lightened for them, nor shall they be respited.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: There will be no relief for them when the torment approaches the unjust nor will they be given any respite.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when those who did wrong (the disbelievers) will see the torment, then it will not be lightened unto them, nor will they be given respite.
english_translations.arberry: And when the evildoers behold the chastisement, it shall not be lightened for them, and no respite shall be given them.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā raā alladhīna ashrakū shurakāahum qālū rabbanā hāulāi shurakāunā alladhīna kunnā nadʿū min dūnika fa-alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūna
ayahs.translation_bn: মুশরিকরা যাদেরকে আল্লাহর শারীক বানিয়েছিল তাদেরকে যখন দেখবে তখন তারা বলবে, ‘হে আমাদের রব্ব! এরাই হল আমাদের শারীক মা‘বূদ তোমাকে বাদ দিয়ে যাদেরকে আমরা ডাকতাম।’ তখন এ কথাকে তাদের দিকেই ছুঁড়ে ফেলে দিয়ে তাদের সেই মা‘বূদরা বলবে, ‘তোমরা অবশ্যই মিথ্যেবাদী।’
ayahs.translation_en: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."
ayahs.conventional_en: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন মুশরিকরা তাদের শরীকদের দেখবে, তখন তারা বলবে, 'হে আমাদের রব! এরা তো আমাদের শরীক, যাদেরকে আমরা তোমাকে বাদ দিয়ে ডাকতাম।' তখন তারা তাদের প্রতি (শরীকরা) বলবে, 'নিশ্চয় তোমরা মিথ্যাবাদী।'

english_translations.sahih_international: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."
english_translations.pickthall: And when those who ascribed partners to Allah behold those partners of theirs, they will say: Our Lord! these are our partners unto whom we used to cry instead of Thee. But they will fling to them the saying: Lo! ye verily are liars!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When those who gave partners to Allah will see their "partners", they will say: "Our Lord! these are our 'partners,' those whom we used to invoke besides Thee." But they will throw back their word at them (and say): "Indeed ye are liars!"
english_translations.shakir: And when those who associate (others with Allah) shall see their associate-gods, they shall say: Our Lord, these are our associate-gods on whom we called besides Thee. But they will give them back the reply: Most surely you are liars.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When the idolators see their idols, they will say, "Lord, these are the idols whom we worshipped instead of you." But the idols will say, "They are liars."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when those who associated partners with Allah see their (Allah's so-called) partners, they will say: "Our Lord! These are our partners whom we used to invoke besides you." But they will throw back their word at them (and say): "Surely! You indeed are liars!"
english_translations.arberry: And when the idolaters behold their associates, they shall say, 'Our Lord, these are our associates on whom we called apart from Thee.' They will fling back at them the saying, 'Surely, you are truly liars.'

ayahs.transliteration: wa-alqaw ilā l-lahi yawma-idhin l-salama waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: সেদিন তারা আল্লাহর নিকট খোলাখুলি আত্মসমর্পণ করবে, আর তারা যে সব মিথ্যে উদ্ভাবন করেছিল তা তাদের নিকট হতে হারিয়ে যাবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর সেদিন তারা আল্লাহর কাছে আত্মসমর্পণ করবে; এবং তারা যা মিথ্যা রচনা করত, সব তাদের থেকে হারিয়ে যাবে।

english_translations.yusuf_ali: That Day shall they (openly) show (their) submission to Allah; and all their inventions shall leave them in the lurch.
english_translations.shakir: And they shall tender submission to Allah on that day; and what they used to forge shall depart from them.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (On the Day of Judgment) the disbelievers will submit themselves to God and whatever they had falsely invented will disappear.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they will offer (their full) submission to Allah (Alone) on that Day, and their invented false deities [all that they used to invoke besides Allah, e.g. idols, saints, priests, monks, angels, jinns, Jibrael (Gabriel), Messengers, etc.] will vanish from them.
english_translations.arberry: And they will offer God surrender that day, and there shall go astray from them that they were forging.

ayahs.transliteration: alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi zid'nāhum ʿadhāban fawqa l-ʿadhābi bimā kānū yuf'sidūna
ayahs.translation_bn: যারা আল্লাহকে অস্বীকার করে আর আল্লাহর পথে বাধা সৃষ্টি করে, আমি তাদের শাস্তির উপর শাস্তি বৃদ্ধি করব, কারণ তারা ফাসাদ সৃষ্টি করত।
ayahs.translation_en: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
ayahs.conventional_en: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যারা কুফর করেছিল এবং আল্লাহর পথ থেকে (মানুষকে) বাধা দিয়েছিল, আমি তাদের শাস্তির ওপর শাস্তি বাড়িয়ে দেব — কারণ তারা বিশৃঙ্খলা সৃষ্টি করত।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: كَفَرُوا۟ (অস্বীকার করেছে) — শব্দমূল [ك ف ر]: অবিশ্বাস করেছে; সত্যের সুস্পষ্ট আলো দেখেও তা মাটিচাপা দিয়ে গোপন করা বা অবাধ্যতায় লিপ্ত থাকা।; ٱللَّهِ (আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।

english_translations.sahih_international: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
english_translations.pickthall: For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Those who reject Allah and hinder (men) from the Path of Allah - for them will We add Penalty to Penalty; for that they used to spread mischief.
english_translations.shakir: (As for) those who disbelieve and turn away from Allah's way, We will add chastisement to their chastisement because they made mischief.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The disbelievers who had created obstacles in the way leading to God will face manifold torments as a result of their evil deeds.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Those who disbelieved and hinder (men) from the Path of Allah, for them We will add torment over the torment; because they used to spread corruption [by disobeying Allah themselves, as well as ordering others (mankind) to do so].
english_translations.arberry: Those that disbelieve and bar from the way of God -- them We shall give increase of chastisement upon chastisement, for that they were doing corruption.

ayahs.transliteration: wayawma nabʿathu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan ʿalayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāulāi wanazzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba tib'yānan likulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan wabush'rā lil'mus'limīna
ayahs.translation_bn: সেদিন আমি প্রত্যেক উম্মাত থেকে তাদের নিজেদেরই মধ্য হতে একজন সাক্ষী দাঁড় করাব, আর (তোমার) এই লোকদের ব্যাপারে সাক্ষ্যদাতা হিসেবে (হে মুহাম্মাদ!) আমি তোমাকে আনব। আমি তোমার প্রতি এ কিতাব নাযিল করেছি যা প্রত্যেকটি বিষয়ের সুস্পষ্ট ব্যাখ্যা, সত্য পথের নির্দেশ, রহমাত আর আত্মসমর্পণকারীদের জন্য সুসংবাদ স্বরূপ।
ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
ayahs.conventional_en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যেদিন আমি প্রত্যেক উম্মতে তাদের নিজেদের মধ্য থেকে একজন সাক্ষী উত্থাপন করব; এবং আমি তোমাকে এদের ওপর সাক্ষী করে নিয়ে আসব; এবং আমি তোমার প্রতি কিতাব নাযিল করেছি — প্রতিটি বিষয়ের স্পষ্ট ব্যাখ্যা, পথপ্রদর্শন, রহমত ও সুসংবাদ — মুসলিমদের জন্য।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ (নিজেদের তাদের) — শব্দমূল [ن ف س]: তাদের নিজেদেরকে; মানব মনস্তত্ত্ব, আত্মচেতনা, স্বতন্ত্র ইচ্ছাশক্তি ও জৈবিক সত্তার সমন্বিত রূপ।; وَهُدًۭى (ও পথ নির্দেশ) — শব্দমূল [ه د ي]: আমাদেরকে দেখান; অপ্টিমাইজড পথনির্দেশ, সত্যের আলো এবং জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ সঠিক অক্ষ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
english_translations.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the day when We raise in every nation a witness against them of their own folk, and We bring thee (Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We reveal the Scripture unto thee as an exposition of all things, and a guidance and a mercy and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: One day We shall raise from all Peoples a witness against them, from amongst themselves: and We shall bring thee as a witness against these (thy people): and We have sent down to thee the Book explaining all things, a Guide, a Mercy, and Glad Tidings to Muslims.
english_translations.shakir: And on the day when We will raise up in every people a witness against them from among themselves, and bring you as a witness against these-- and We have revealed the Book to you explaining clearly everything, and a guidance and mercy and good news for those who submit.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when We call a witness against every nation from their own people, We will call you, (Muhammad), as a witness against them all. We have sent you the Book which clarifies all matters. It is a guide, a mercy, and glad news to the Muslims.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (remember) the Day when We shall raise up from every nation a witness against them from amongst themselves. And We shall bring you (O Muhammad SAW) as a witness against these. And We have sent down to you the Book (the Quran) as an exposition of everything, a guidance, a mercy, and glad tidings for those who have submitted themselves (to Allah as Muslims).
english_translations.arberry: And the day We shall raise up from every nation a witness against them from amongst them, and We shall bring thee as a witness against those. And We have sent down on thee the Book making clear everything, and as a guidance and a mercy, and as good tidings to those who surrender.

ayahs.transliteration: inna l-laha yamuru bil-ʿadli wal-iḥ'sāni waītāi dhī l-qur'bā wayanhā ʿani l-faḥshāi wal-munkari wal-baghyi yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ ন্যায়-বিচার, সদাচরণ ও আত্মীয়দেরকে দেয়ার হুকুম দিচ্ছেন, আর তিনি নিষেধ করছেন অশ্লীলতা, অপকর্ম আর বিদ্রোহ থেকে। তিনি তোমাদেরকে উপদেশ দিয়েছেন যাতে তোমরা শিক্ষা গ্রহণ কর।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
ayahs.conventional_bn: নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ ইনসাফ, ইহসান ও আত্মীয়স্বজনকে দান করার আদেশ দেন; এবং তিনি অশ্লীলতা, খারাপ কাজ ও সীমালঙ্ঘন থেকে নিষেধ করেন; তিনি তোমাদের উপদেশ দেন — যাতে তোমরা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করো।

metadata.meta_en: The Supreme Ethical Code of Balance & Justice

ayahs.meta_en: The Supreme Ethical Code of Balance & Justice
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهَ (আল্লাহ্‌) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; بِٱلْعَدْلِ (ব্যাপারে ন্যায়ের) — শব্দমূল [ع د ل]: কোনো বিনিময়; প্রতিটি বস্তুকে তার যথাযথ স্থানে স্থাপন এবং নিরপেক্ষ নিখুঁত ইনসাফ প্রতিষ্ঠা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Allah commands justice, the doing of good, and liberality to kith and kin, and He forbids all shameful deeds, and injustice and rebellion: He instructs you, that ye may receive admonition.
english_translations.shakir: Surely Allah enjoins the doing of justice and the doing of good (to others) and the giving to the kindred, and He forbids indecency and evil and rebellion; He admonishes you that you may be mindful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God commands (people) to maintain justice, kindness, and proper relations with their relatives. He forbids them to commit indecency, sin, and rebellion. God gives you advice so that perhaps you will take heed.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, Allah enjoins Al-Adl (i.e. justice and worshipping none but Allah Alone - Islamic Monotheism) and Al-Ihsan [i.e. to be patient in performing your duties to Allah, totally for Allah's sake and in accordance with the Sunnah (legal ways) of the Prophet SAW in a perfect manner], and giving (help) to kith and kin (i.e. all that Allah has ordered you to give them e.g., wealth, visiting, looking after them, or any other kind of help, etc.): and forbids Al-Fahsha' (i.e. all evil deeds, e.g. illegal sexual acts, disobedience of parents, polytheism, to tell lies, to give false witness, to kill a life without right, etc.), and Al-Munkar (i.e. all that is prohibited by Islamic law: polytheism of every kind, disbelief and every kind of evil deeds, etc.), and Al-Baghy (i.e. all kinds of oppression), He admonishes you, that you may take heed.
english_translations.arberry: Surely God bids to justice and good-doing and giving to kinsmen; and He forbids indecency, dishonour, and insolence, admonishing you, so that haply you will remember.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-awfū biʿahdi l-lahi idhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu l-laha ʿalaykum kafīlan inna l-laha yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা পরস্পর অঙ্গীকারে আবদ্ধ হলে আল্লাহর অঙ্গীকার পূর্ণ করবে, নিজেদের অঙ্গীকার পাকা-পোখত করার পর তা ভঙ্গ করো না, যেহেতু তোমরা আল্লাহকে নিজেদের উপর সাক্ষী বানিয়ে নিয়েছ, তোমরা যা কর আল্লাহ সে সম্পর্কে ওয়াকেফহাল।
ayahs.translation_en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.
ayahs.conventional_en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা আল্লাহর সাথে করা অঙ্গীকার পূর্ণ করো — যখন তোমরা অঙ্গীকার করো; এবং শপথকে দৃঢ় করার পর তা ভঙ্গ করো না; আর তোমরা তো আল্লাহকে নিজেদের ওপর দায়ী করেছ; নিশ্চয় আল্লাহ জানেন তোমরা কী করো।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ (আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; وَأَوْفُوا۟ (তোমরা পূর্ণ করো) — শব্দমূল [و ف ي]: এবং তোমরা পূর্ণ করো; ধ্রুপদী অভিধানে মূল ধাতু নির্দেশ করে 'এবং তোমরা পূর্ণ করো'; আয়াতে যা আত্মিক সচেতনতা, নীতিগত ভারসাম্য ও জীবন ব্যবস্থার শৃঙ্খলার প্রতিফলন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.
english_translations.pickthall: Fulfil the covenant of Allah when ye have covenanted, and break not your oaths after the asseveration of them, and after ye have made Allah surety over you. Lo! Allah knoweth what ye do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Fulfil the Covenant of Allah when ye have entered into it, and break not your oaths after ye have confirmed them; indeed ye have made Allah your surety; for Allah knoweth all that ye do.
english_translations.shakir: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have made a covenant, and do not break the oaths after making them fast, and you have indeed made Allah a surety for you; surely Allah knows what you do.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (He commands people) to keep their established covenants with God, not to disregard their firm oaths; they have already appointed God as their Guarantor. God certainly knows what you do.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And fulfill the Covenant of Allah (Bai'a: pledge for Islam) when you have covenanted, and break not the oaths after you have confirmed them, and indeed you have appointed Allah your surety. Verily! Allah knows what you do.
english_translations.arberry: Fulfil God's covenant, when you make covenant, and break not the oaths after they have been confirmed, and you have made God your surety; surely God knows the things you do.

ayahs.transliteration: walā takūnū ka-allatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin innamā yablūkumu l-lahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma l-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা এমন নারীর মত হয়ো না যে তার সূতাগুলোকে শক্ত করে পাকানোর পর নিজেই তার পাক খুলে টুকরো টুকরো করে দেয়। তোমরা তোমাদের শপথগুলোকে পারস্পরিক ব্যাপারে ধোঁকা-প্রতারণার হাতিয়ার হিসেবে ব্যবহার কর যেন একদল আরেক দল অপেক্ষা বেশি ফায়দা লাভ করতে পারে। আল্লাহ কেবল এর দ্বারা তোমাদেরকে পরীক্ষা করেন। আল্লাহ ক্বিয়ামাতের দিন অবশ্য অবশ্যই স্পষ্ট করে দিবেন যে বিষয়ে তোমরা মতভেদ করতে।

words.translation_bn: এবং তিনি অবশ্যই স্পষ্ট করে দেবেন
words.translation_en: and He will surely make clear

ayahs.translation_en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা সেই মহিলার মতো হয়ো না, যে তার সুতা শক্তভাবে বোনার পর তা খণ্ডিত করে ফেলে; তোমরা তোমাদের শপথকে প্রতারণার মাধ্যমে গ্রহণ করো — এ কারণে যে, একটি সম্প্রদায় অন্যটির চেয়ে বেশি সংখ্যক; আল্লাহ তো এর মাধ্যমেই তোমাদের পরীক্ষা করেন; এবং কিয়ামতের দিন তিনি তোমাদের কাছে স্পষ্ট করে দেবেন — যা নিয়ে তোমরা মতভেদ করছিলে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
english_translations.pickthall: And be not like unto her who unravelleth the thread, after she hath made it strong, to thin filaments, making your oaths a deceit between you because of a nation being more numerous than (another) nation. Allah only trieth you thereby, and He verily will explain to you on the Day of Resurrection that wherein ye differed.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And be not like a woman who breaks into untwisted strands the yarn which she has spun, after it has become strong. Nor take your oaths to practise deception between yourselves, lest one party should be more numerous than another: for Allah will test you by this; and on the Day of Judgment He will certainly make clear to you (the truth of) that wherein ye disagree.
english_translations.shakir: And be not like her who unravels her yarn, disintegrating it into pieces after she has spun it strongly. You make your oaths to be means of deceit between you because (one) nation is more numerous than (another) nation. Allah only tries you by this; and He will most certainly make clear to you on the resurrection day that about which you differed.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not be like the lady behind the spinning wheel who has broken the yarn by pulling it with unnecessary force. You must not consider your oaths as means of deceit to benefit one party and incur loss upon the other. God tests your faith by your oaths. He will make clear to you who was right and who was wrong on the Day of Judgment.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And be not like her who undoes the thread which she has spun after it has become strong, by taking your oaths a means of deception among yourselves, lest a nation may be more numerous than another nation. Allah only tests you by this [i.e. who obeys Allah and fulfills Allah's Covenant and who disobeys Allah and breaks Allah's Covenant]. And on the Day of Resurrection, He will certainly make clear to you that wherein you used to differ [i.e. a believer confesses and believes in the Oneness of Allah and in the Prophethood of Prophet Muhammad SAW which the disbeliever denies it and that was their difference amongst them in the life of this world].
english_translations.arberry: And be not as a woman who breaks her thread, after it is firmly spun, into fibres, by taking your oaths as mere mutual deceit, one nation being more numerous than another nation. God only tries you thereby; and certainly He will make clear to you upon the Day of Resurrection that whereon you were at variance.

ayahs.transliteration: walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu walatus'alunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ ইচ্ছে করলে তোমাদেরকে অবশ্যই এক উম্মাত করে দিতেন, কিন্তু তিনি যাকে ইচ্ছে গুমরাহ্ করেন, আর যাকে ইচ্ছে সঠিক পথপ্রদর্শন করেন। তোমরা যা কর সে সম্পর্কে অবশ্য অবশ্যই তোমাদেরকে জিজ্ঞাসাবাদ করা হবে।

words.translation_en: He would surely have made you

words.translation_bn: এবং তোমাদের অবশ্যই প্রশ্ন করা হবে
words.translation_en: And you will surely be questioned

ayahs.translation_en: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
ayahs.conventional_en: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যদি আল্লাহ চাইতেন, তবে তিনি তোমাদের একক সম্প্রদায় করতেন; কিন্তু তিনি যাকে ইচ্ছা পথভ্রষ্ট করেন এবং যাকে ইচ্ছা পথপ্রদর্শন করেন; আর তোমরা যা করতে, সে সম্পর্কে অবশ্যই জিজ্ঞাসিত হবে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
english_translations.pickthall: Had Allah willed He could have made you (all) one nation, but He sendeth whom He will astray and guideth whom He will, and ye will indeed be asked of what ye used to do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If Allah so willed, He could make you all one people: But He leaves straying whom He pleases, and He guides whom He pleases: but ye shall certainly be called to account for all your actions.
english_translations.shakir: And if Allah please He would certainly make you a single nation, but He causes to err whom He pleases and guides whom He pleases; and most certainly you will be questioned as to what you did.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Had God wanted, He would have made you one single nation but He guides or causes to go astray whomever He wants. You will certainly be questioned about what you have done.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And had Allah willed, He could have made you (all) one nation, but He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. But you shall certainly be called to account for what you used to do.
english_translations.arberry: If God had willed, He would have made you one nation; but He leads astray whom He will, and guides whom He will; and you will surely be questioned about the things you wrought.

ayahs.transliteration: walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqū l-sūa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli l-lahi walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা তোমাদের নিজেদের শপথগুলোকে পরস্পর ধোঁকা-প্রবঞ্চনার উপায় হিসেবে গ্রহণ করো না, তা করলে দৃঢ়ভাবে প্রতিষ্ঠিত হওয়ার পর পা আবার পিছলে যাবে, আর আল্লাহর পথে বাধা দেয়ার কারণে তোমরা মন্দ পরিণতি ভোগ করবে, আর তোমাদের জন্য থাকবে কঠিন শাস্তি।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা তোমাদের শপথকে প্রতারণার হাতিয়ার বানিয়ো না; তাহলে পা দৃঢ় হওয়ার পর পিছলে যাবে; এবং তোমরা মন্দের স্বাদ গ্রহণ করবে — কারণ তোমরা আল্লাহর পথ থেকে বাধা দিয়েছিলে; আর তোমাদের জন্য রয়েছে মহাশাস্তি।

ayahs.meta_en: The Destabilizing Effect of Oath Breach
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ ۖ (আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; عَظِيمٌۭ (মহাকঠিন) — শব্দমূল [ع ظ م]: কঠিন; ভ্রূণে তরুণাস্থি থেকে শক্ত অস্থি ও কঙ্কাল ফ্রেমওয়ার্কের সুনির্দিষ্ট গঠন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
english_translations.pickthall: Make not your oaths a deceit between you, lest a foot should slip after being firmly planted and ye should taste evil forasmuch as ye debarred (men) from the way of Allah, and yours should be an awful doom.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And take not your oaths, to practise deception between yourselves, with the result that someone's foot may slip after it was firmly planted, and ye may have to taste the evil (consequences) of having hindered (men) from the Path of Allah, and a Mighty Wrath descend on you.
english_translations.shakir: And do not make your oaths a means of deceit between you, lest a foot should slip after its stability and you should taste evil because you turned away from Allah's way and grievous punishment be your (lot).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not consider your oaths as a means of deceit lest you damage the firmness of your faith, suffer from evil by creating obstacles in the way that leads to God, and incur a great torment upon yourselves.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And make not your oaths, a means of deception among yourselves, lest a foot may slip after being firmly planted, and you may have to taste the evil (punishment in this world) of having hindered (men) from the Path of Allah (i.e. Belief in the Oneness of Allah and His Messenger, Muhammad SAW), and yours will be a great torment (i.e. the Fire of Hell in the Hereafter).
english_translations.arberry: Take not your oaths as mere mutual deceit, lest any foot should slip after it has stood firm, and you should taste evil, for that you barred from the way of God, and lest there should await you a mighty chastisement.

ayahs.transliteration: walā tashtarū biʿahdi l-lahi thamanan qalīlan innamā ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taʿlamūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা আল্লাহর সঙ্গে কৃত ওয়া‘দা নগণ্য মূল্যে বিক্রয় করো না। আল্লাহর নিকট যা আছে তোমাদের জন্য তা-ই উত্তম- তোমরা যদি জানতে!
ayahs.translation_en: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তোমরা আল্লাহর অঙ্গীকারকে সামান্য মূল্যে বিক্রয় করো না; নিশ্চয় আল্লাহর কাছে যা আছে, তা তোমাদের জন্য উত্তম — যদি তোমরা জানতে!

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.
english_translations.pickthall: And purchase not a small gain at the price of Allah's covenant. Lo! that which Allah hath is better for you, if ye did but know.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nor sell the covenant of Allah for a miserable price: for with Allah is (a prize) far better for you, if ye only knew.
english_translations.shakir: And do not take a small price in exchange for Allah's covenant; surely what is with Allah is better for you, did you but know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not sell your covenant with God for a small price. The reward which you will receive from God is better for you, if only you knew it.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And purchase not a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant. Verily! What is with Allah is better for you if you did but know.
english_translations.arberry: And do not sell the covenant of God for a small price; surely what is with God -- that is better for you, did you but know.

ayahs.transliteration: mā ʿindakum yanfadu wamā ʿinda l-lahi bāqin walanajziyanna alladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাদের কাছে যা আছে তা শেষ হয়ে যাবে, আর আল্লাহর কাছে যা আছে তা টিকে থাকবে। আমরা অবশ্য অবশ্যই ধৈর্যশীলদেরকে তারা যা করে তার চেয়ে উত্তম প্রতিদান দেব।
ayahs.translation_en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.conventional_en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমাদের কাছে যা আছে, তা ফুরিয়ে যায়; আর আল্লাহর কাছে যা আছে, তা স্থায়ী; এবং আমি অবশ্যই যারা ধৈর্য ধারণ করেছে, তাদেরকে তাদের পুরস্কার দেব — তারা যা সবচেয়ে ভালো কাজ করত, তার ভিত্তিতে।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ٱللَّهِ (আল্লাহর) — শব্দমূল [ا ل ه]: আল্লাহ র; একমাত্র উপাস্য, মহাজাগতিক আদি উৎস ও সমস্ত উপাসনার যোগ্য পরম ঈশ্বর।; صَبَرُوٓا۟ (ধৈর্য ধরেছে) — শব্দমূল [ص ب ر]: ধৈর্যের মাধ্যমে; মানসিক স্থিতিস্থাপকতা, প্রতিকূলতায় অটল থাকা ও আবেগীয় তাড়না নিয়ন্ত্রণ করার সর্বোচ্চ সামর্থ্য।

english_translations.sahih_international: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
english_translations.pickthall: That which ye have wasteth away, and that which Allah hath remaineth. And verily We shall pay those who are steadfast a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: What is with you must vanish: what is with Allah will endure. And We will certainly bestow, on those who patiently persevere, their reward according to the best of their actions.
english_translations.shakir: What is with you passes away and what is with Allah is enduring; and We will most certainly give to those who are patient their reward for the best of what they did.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whatever you possess is transient and whatever is with God is everlasting. We will recompense those who exercise patience with their due reward and even more.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Whatever is with you, will be exhausted, and whatever with Allah (of good deeds) will remain. And those who are patient, We will certainly pay them a reward in proportion to the best of what they used to do.
english_translations.arberry: What is with you comes to an end, but what is with God abides; and surely We shall recompense those who were patient their wage, according to the best of what they did.

ayahs.transliteration: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuḥ'yiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani mā kānū yaʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: পুরুষ আর নারীদের মধ্যে যে কেউ সৎকাজ করবে আর সে মু’মিনও, তাকে আমি অবশ্য অবশ্যই উত্তম জীবন দান করব আর তাদেরকে অবশ্য অবশ্যই তারা যা করে তার চেয়ে উত্তম প্রতিফল দান করব।

words.translation_bn: তবে অবশ্যই আমরা তাকে জীবন দান করব
words.translation_en: We will surely grant him life

words.translation_bn: এবং অবশ্যই আমরা তাদের প্রতিদান দেব
words.translation_en: and We will surely reward them

ayahs.translation_en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.conventional_en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: যে ব্যক্তি সৎকর্ম করে — পুরুষ বা নারী — এবং সে মুমিন, আমি তাকে উত্তম জীবন দান করব; এবং আমি তাদেরকে তাদের পুরস্কার দেব — তারা যা সবচেয়ে ভালো কাজ করত, তার ভিত্তিতে।

metadata.consistency_4_82: ৪:৮২ লজিক্যাল কনসিস্টেন্সি ও শব্দমূলের সার্বজনীন ফিল্টারে সম্পূর্ণ সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ذَكَرٍ (পুরুষদের) — শব্দমূল [ذ ك ر]: তোমরা স্মরণ করো; স্মরণ, সচেতন মনোযোগ, সক্রিয় মেমোরি রিকল ও সোর্স কোডের সাথে সর্বদা সংযোগ রক্ষা।; مُؤْمِنٌۭ (ঈমানদারও) — শব্দমূল [ا م ن]: বিশ্বাস করে; অন্তরের গভীর প্রশান্তি, সত্যের প্রতি পূর্ণ আস্থা ও চিরন্তন নিরাপত্তার বলয়ে প্রবেশ।

english_translations.sahih_international: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
english_translations.pickthall: Whosoever doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, him verily we shall quicken with good life, and We shall pay them a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Whoever works righteousness, man or woman, and has Faith, verily, to him will We give a new Life, a life that is good and pure and We will bestow on such their reward according to the best of their actions.
english_translations.shakir: Whoever does good whether male or female and he is a believer, We will most certainly make him live a happy life, and We will most certainly give them their reward for the best of what they did.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: All righteously believing male or female will be granted a blessed happy life and will receive their due reward and more.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Whoever works righteousness, whether male or female, while he (or she) is a true believer (of Islamic Monotheism) verily, to him We will give a good life (in this world with respect, contentment and lawful provision), and We shall pay them certainly a reward in proportion to the best of what they used to do (i.e. Paradise in the Hereafter).
english_translations.arberry: And whosoever does a righteous deed, be it male or female, believing, We shall assuredly give him to live a goodly life; and We shall recompense them their wage, according to the best of what they did.

ayahs.transliteration: fa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi mina l-shayṭāni l-rajīmi
ayahs.translation_bn: তুমি যখনি কুরআন পাঠ করবে তখন অভিশপ্ত শয়ত্বান থেকে আল্লাহর নিকট আশ্রয় চাইবে।
ayahs.translation_en: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
ayahs.conventional_en: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতএব যখন তুমি কুরআন পাঠ করো, তখন বিতাড়িত শয়তান থেকে আল্লাহর কাছে আশ্রয় প্রার্থনা করো।
